

# 
# 变量说明:
#   
#   所有XY指示变量 均 先均值标准化, 再基期标准化
# 
# 所有带下划线的都是非基期标准化变量
# 
# 基期标准化：
# wfdms12 wfdms16 wfdms18 wfdms20 wfdms22
# 未均值标准化
# wfdss12 wfdss16 wfdss18 wfdss20 wfdss22 SD绝对值
# !wfdds12 wfdds16 wfdds18 wfdds20 wfdds22 女性-其他
# !wfdds112 wfdds116 wfdds118 wfdds120 wfdds122 老大-其他
# !wfdds412 wfdds416 wfdds418 wfdds420 wfdds422 长子-其他
# !ces8sd12 ces8sd16 ces8sd18 ces8sd20 ces8sd22
# 已均值标准化
# wfdcs12 wfdcs16 wfdcs18 wfdcs20 wfdcs22 SD/Mean=COV变异系数
# !wfdds712 wfdds716 wfdds718 wfdds720 wfdds722 女性-其他
# !wfdds812 wfdds816 wfdds818 wfdds820 wfdds822 老大-其他
# !wfdds912 wfdds916 wfdds918 wfdds920 wfdds922 长子-其他
# !ces8sd12 ces8sd16 ces8sd18 ces8sd20 ces8sd22
# 
# 均值标准化的必要性:
#   由于mean与SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff存在强相关, 使用PP-LGCM估计SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff的净效应需要将Mean影响剔除,
# 当使用SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff的原始测量时, 控制Mean的方式有以下四种:
#   1.将各期的Mean作为PP-LGCM时变控制变量TVCs
# 2.将基期的Mean作为PP-LGCM非时变控制变量TICs
# 3.将Mean的轨迹因子截距和斜率与SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff的轨迹因子截距和斜率设定共变WTIH
# 4.将Mean的轨迹因子截距和斜率作为控制变量纳入回归(除了Mean因子，其他都不显著)
# 
# 方法4, 最贴近"在控制Mean均值/斜率不变的情况下，SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff的效应", 由于mean与SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff存在强相关，
# 极易触发多重共线性，导致标准误膨胀，系数不显著。
# 
# 为此，必须在mean与SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff的测量上将Mean的影响去除(显著), 即 均值标准化;
# 
# 均值标准化的局限性:
#   使用"SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff的均值标准化值"导致类别概率极不均匀, 此处建议使用"SD\gender_diff\sibling_diff的原始值"探索潜类别

# ==============================================================================
# 0. 无条件单变量LGCM 轨迹形态 & 最优模型参数估计 
# ==============================================================================
# 对于LGCM而言, 基期标准化前后, 模型拟合指标CFI/TLI/RSMER均不变, AIC/BIC, LGCM增长因子系数有变化, 但斜率、方差的显著性似乎不变,
# 因此基期标准化 不会改变模型.

##### 未基期标准化
### 无条件单变量LGCM(未基期标准化: 先未均值标准化, 再均值标准化)

    # linear
    
    pp_lgca <- mplusObject( 
      TITLE = glue(
        "Class-1_pp_LGCA"),
      
      VARIABLE = glue(
        "usevar =

processors = 10;
coverage = 0.005;",

          # Parameters 和 Observations 设为 integer，其余 numeric
          if (col %in% c("Parameters", "Observations")) {
            interge_extract.process_i_j[[col]] <- NA_integer_
          } else {
            interge_extract.process_i_j[[col]] <- NA_real_
          }
        }
      }
      
      # 添加 TITLE 列（记录来源，如 interge_extract.process1_linear）
      interge_extract.process_i_j <- interge_extract.process_i_j %>%
        mutate(TITLE = paste0("interge_extract.process", i, "_", j)) %>%
        select(all_of(required_cols))  # 强制列顺序（含 TITLE）
      
      # 存入临时列表（以 j 命名）
      temp_list[[j]] <- interge_extract.process_i_j
    }
    
    # 合并当前 i 的 3 个 j 数据框（linear, quadratic, piecewise, shape_factor）
    allFit.process_i <- do.call(rbind, temp_list)
    
    # 动态赋值给 allFit.process{i}
    assign(paste0("allFit.process", i), allFit.process_i)
  }
  
  # 合并所有 allFit.process{i}（共 5 × 3 = 15 行）
  allFit <- rbind(allFit.process1, allFit.process2, allFit.process3, allFit.process4, allFit.process5,
                  allFit.process6, allFit.process7, allFit.process8, allFit.process9, allFit.process10) %>% 
    mutate(Title = substr(TITLE, start = 26, stop = nchar(TITLE))) %>%
    select(-TITLE)
  
  # 验证结果
  View(allFit)
  
  
  
  #Format Fit Table
  #模型拟合指标做表
  tab.allFit.lgcm <- allFit %>%
    gt() %>% #创建了一个空的gt对象,用于后续的表格构建.
    tab_header( #设置表格的标题和副标题,md()使用Markdown格式来设置标题
      title = md("**Model Fit Summary Table**")) %>%
    cols_label( #设置表格各列的标签,用于在表头显示
      Title = md("*Classes*"),
      Parameters = md("*Par*"),
      CFI = md("*CFI*"),
      TLI = md("*TLI*"),
      RMSEA_Estimate = md("*RMSEA*"),
      AIC = md("*AIC*"),
      BIC = md("*BIC*"),
      Observations = md("N")) %>%
    #   tab_footnote( #设置表格的脚注信息.
    #     footnote = md(
    #       "*Note.* Par = Parameters; *LL* = model log likelihood;
    # BIC = Bayesian information criterion;
    # aBIC = sample size adjusted BIC; CAIC = consistent Akaike information criterion;
    # AWE = approximate weight of evidence criterion;
    # BLRT = bootstrapped likelihood ratio test p-value;
    # VLMR = Vuong-Lo-Mendell-Rubin adjusted likelihood ratio test p-value;
    # BF = Bayes Factor;
    # *cmPk* = approximate correct model probability;
    # Entropy is included in the table for brevity but should not be used as a model
    # selection statistic (Masyn, 2013)."),
    #     locations = cells_title()) %>% #footnote的位置
    #   tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold") %>% #设置表格的选项,列标签的字体加粗.
    #   fmt_number(11,decimals = 3, #设置第11列Entropy的格式, 小数位数/末尾零不删除等
    #              drop_trailing_zeros=FALSE,
    #              suffixing = TRUE) %>%
    #   fmt_number(c(3:10,12),
    #              decimals = 3) %>% #其他列保留3位小数.
    sub_missing(1:8,
                missing_text = "--") %>% #设置缺失值的显示文本为"--"
    # fmt(c(9:10,13), #第8\9\12列,如果x<0.001则显示为"<0.001";否则显示原值,并精确到小数点后3位.
    #     fns = function(x)
    #       ifelse(x<0.001, "<.001",
    #              scales::number(x, accuracy = 0.001))) %>% 
    # fmt(12, fns = function(x) ##第11列,如果x>100则显示为">100";否则显示原值,小数点后1位.
    #   ifelse(x>100, ">100",
    #          scales::number(x, accuracy = .1))) %>% 
    ### 行分组
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-1(Mean)",
      rows = 1:4) %>% #设置行分组,将"Time-1"划分为1组,分布在1值6行.
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-2(SD)",
      rows = 5:8) %>%
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-3(Sex diff)",
      rows = 9:12) %>% #设置行分组,将"Time-1"划分为1组,分布在1值6行.
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-4(Sibling diff)",
      rows = 13:16) %>%
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-4(Sibling4 diff)",
      rows = 17:20) %>%
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-2(SD/Mean)",
      rows = 21:24) %>%
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-3(Sex diff/Mean)",
      rows = 25:28) %>% #设置行分组,将"Time-1"划分为1组,分布在1值6行.
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-4(Sibling diff/Mean)",
      rows = 29:32) %>%
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-4(Sibling4 diff/Mean)",
      rows = 33:36) %>%
    tab_row_group(
      label = "Process-5(CESD-8)",
      rows = 37:40) %>% #设置行分组,将"Time-1"划分为1组,分布在1值6行.
    
    row_group_order(
      group = c("Process-1(Mean)",
                "Process-2(SD)","Process-3(Sex diff)","Process-4(Sibling diff)","Process-4(Sibling4 diff)",
                "Process-2(SD/Mean)","Process-3(Sex diff/Mean)","Process-4(Sibling diff/Mean)","Process-4(Sibling4 diff/Mean)",
                "Process-5(CESD-8)")  #设置行分组的显示顺序,"Time-1","Time-2","Time-3".
    )
  
  print(tab.allFit.lgcm)
  
  
  ## 使用gtsave()保存表格
  filename <- paste0("single_process_lgca_fit_summary_table of CES-D8")
  
  ## 存为.docx  
  # 覆盖已有文件时会报错(加入if函数提前删除重复文件，避免报错)
  if (file.exists(paste0(filename,".docx"))) {
    file.remove(paste0(filename,".docx"))
  }
  
  gtsave(tab.allFit.lgcm, filename = paste0(filepath,filename,".docx") )

        clo.name = case_when(
          str_detect(paramHeader, "WITH") ~ "WITH",
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Means") & str_detect(param, "I") ~ "Means.I",
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Means") & str_detect(param, "S") ~ "Means.S",
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Variances") & str_detect(param, "I") ~ "Variances.I",
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Variances") & str_detect(param, "S") ~ "Variances.S",
          TRUE ~ paramHeader
        ),
        sig = case_when(
          pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
          pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
          TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        est_pval_se_type = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                  sprintf("%.3f", se), ")"),
        # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 
        sort_group1 = case_when(
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Means") ~ 0,
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Variances") ~ 1,
          str_detect(paramHeader, "WITH") ~ 2
        ),
        sort_group2 = case_when(
          str_detect(param, "I") ~ 0,
          str_detect(param, "S") ~ 1
        )
      ) %>% 
      # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
      arrange(sort_group1,sort_group2) %>% 
      select(clo.name, est_pval_se_type) %>% 
      # 重命名列
      rename(!!paste0("est_pval_se_type", i) := est_pval_se_type)

        "Class-1_pp_LGCA"),
      
      VARIABLE = glue(

!starts = 600 200;
!starts = 20;
!LRTBOOTSTRAP = 200;
processors = 10;
coverage = 0.005;",
      
      MODEL = 
        "
i1 s1 | wfdms12@0 wfdms16@4 wfdms18@6 wfdms20@8 wfdms22@10;
!i2 s2 | wfdss12@0 wfdss16@4 wfdss18@6 wfdss20@8 wfdss22@10;

!i5 s5 | ces8sd12@0 ces8sd16@4 ces8sd18@6 ces8sd20@8 ces8sd22@10; 
",
      
      OUTPUT = 
        "tech1 tech4 sampstat patterns stdyx;",

      # SAVE = CPROB;"),

    pp_lgca_fit <- mplusModeler(pp_lgca, 
                                dataout = "lgca_process1_linear.dat", 
                                modelout = glue("lgca_process1_linear_baseline_std.inp"), 
                                check = TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE)

!i2 s2 q2 | wfdss12@0 wfdss16@4 wfdss18@6 wfdss20@8 wfdss22@10; 
!i3 s3 q3 | wfdds12@0 wfdds16@4 wfdds18@6 wfdds20@8 wfdds22@10; 
!i4 s4 q4 | wfdds112@0 wfdds116@4 wfdds118@6 wfdds120@8 wfdds122@10;

{
  library(dplyr)
  library(MplusAutomation)
  library(here)

  ## process2
  output.cesd8.process2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process2_shape_factor_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  ## process3
  output.cesd8.process3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process3_linear_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  ## process4
  output.cesd8.process4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process4_linear_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  ## process44
  output.cesd8.process5 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process44_shape_factor_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  ## process2r
  output.cesd8.process6 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process2r_shape_factor_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  ## process3r
  output.cesd8.process7 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process3r_linear_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  ## process4r
  output.cesd8.process8 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process4r_linear_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  ## process44r
  output.cesd8.process9 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process44r_linear_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  ## process5
  output.cesd8.process10 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_process5_shape_factor_baseline_std.out"), quiet = TRUE)
  
  ##### 制表模型结果
  
  for (i in 1:10) {
    
    # 动态获取输入数据框
    output.interge.process_i <- get(paste0("output.cesd8.process",i))
    
    # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
    model.result.type_i <- output.interge.process_i[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
      # 截距 和 斜率的均值,方差,相关系数
      filter(paramHeader %in% c("Means", "Variances") | str_detect(paramHeader, "WITH$")) %>% 
      mutate(
        across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
        clo.name = case_when(
          str_detect(paramHeader, "WITH") ~ "WITH",
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Means") & str_detect(param, "I") ~ "Means.I",
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Means") & str_detect(param, "S") ~ "Means.S",
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Variances") & str_detect(param, "I") ~ "Variances.I",
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Variances") & str_detect(param, "S") ~ "Variances.S",
          TRUE ~ paramHeader
        ),
        sig = case_when(
          pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
          pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
          TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        est_pval_se_type = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                  sprintf("%.3f", se), ")"),
        # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 
        sort_group1 = case_when(
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Means") ~ 0,
          str_detect(paramHeader, "Variances") ~ 1,
          str_detect(paramHeader, "WITH") ~ 2
        ),
        sort_group2 = case_when(
          str_detect(param, "I") ~ 0,
          str_detect(param, "S") ~ 1
        )
      ) %>% 
      # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
      arrange(sort_group1,sort_group2) %>% 
      select(clo.name, est_pval_se_type) %>% 
      # 重命名列
      rename(!!paste0("est_pval_se_type", i) := est_pval_se_type)
    
    # model.result.type1
    
    # 动态赋值给model.result.type_i
    assign(paste0("model.result.type", i), model.result.type_i)
    
  }
  
  
  ### 均值
  # # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
  # model.result.type1 <- output.cesd8.process1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
  #   # 截距 和 斜率的均值,方差,相关系数

  # 
  # model.result.type1
  
  model.result.type1
  model.result.type2
  model.result.type3

  model.result.type5

  ##### 合并所有结果表
  model.result.all <- model.result.type1 %>%
    cbind(
      model.result.type2 %>% select(est_pval_se_type2),
      model.result.type3 %>% select(est_pval_se_type3),
      model.result.type4 %>% select(est_pval_se_type4),

    mutate( model_type=case_when(
      model_type == "est_pval_se_type1" ~ "Mean",
      model_type == "est_pval_se_type2" ~ "SD",
      model_type == "est_pval_se_type3" ~ "Gender",

      model_type == "est_pval_se_type6" ~ "SD/Mean",

      model_type == "est_pval_se_type8" ~ "Sibling/Mean",
      model_type == "est_pval_se_type9" ~ "Sibling4/Mean",
      model_type == "est_pval_se_type10" ~ "CESD8"
    )
    )
  
  # 重命名列为原来的 clo.name 值
  colnames(model.result.all)[2:6] <- c("Means.I", "Means.S", "Variances.I", "Variances.S", "WITH")
  
  model.result.all
  
  ##### 使用gt()包导出表格
  model.result.all.t <- model.result.all %>%
    gt(rowname_col = "model_type") %>%
    # tab_options(

    # ) %>% 
    tab_header(

    ) %>%

    tab_spanner(label = "Variances", columns = 4:5) %>% 
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(align = "center", whitespace = "pre-wrap"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = c(2:6))  # c(亲密无间型,生活照料型,经济帮助型,独立疏远型)
    )  %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold",),
      locations = cells_row_groups()
    )  %>%
    tab_footnote( 
      footnote = md(paste0("Notes . Intercept represents baseline, Slope represents growth rate; all of the intercept parts were fixed at 1; Mean,SD,Gender,CESD8 are level factor trend, Sibling is linear trend. Unstandardized coeffcients are presented. Standard errors in parentheses. <br>\n", 
                           "\\+ p < 0.1, * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001")),
      locations = cells_body(columns = "Means.I",

    ) %>% gt::fmt_markdown(columns = everything()) 
  
  print(model.result.all.t)

### 先CFI再TLI再BIC再AIC, 最优模型如下:
# Process-1(Mean) <- shape_factor
# 绝对差异
# Process-2(SD) <- shape_factor
# Process-3(Sex diff) <- linear
# Process-4(Sibling diff) <- linear
# Process-4(Sibling diff4) <- shape_factor
# 相对差异=绝对差异/均值
# Process-2(SD/Mean) <- shape_factor
# Process-3(Sex diff/Mean) <- linear
# Process-4(Sibling diff/Mean) <- linear
# Process-4(Sibling diff4/Mean) <- linear

# Process-5(CESD-8) <- shape_factor

# 均值轨迹
# i1 s1 | wfdms12@0 wfdms16*4 wfdms18*6 wfdms20*8 wfdms22@10;

# 绝对差异
# i2 s2 | wfdss12@0 wfdss16*4 wfdss18*6 wfdss20*8 wfdss22@10; 
# i3 s3 | wfdds12@0 wfdds16@4 wfdds18@6 wfdds20@8 wfdds22@10; 
# i4 s4 | wfdds112@0 wfdds116@4 wfdds118@6 wfdds120@8 wfdds122@10;
# i4 s4 | wfdds412@0 wfdds416@4 wfdds418@6 wfdds420@8 wfdds422@10;

# 相对差异=绝对差异/均值
# i2 s2 | wfdcs12@0 wfdcs16*4 wfdcs18*6 wfdcs20*8 wfdcs22@10; 
# i3 s3 | wfdds712@0 wfdds716@4 wfdds718@6 wfdds720@8 wfdds722@10; 
# i4 s4 | wfdds812@0 wfdds816@4 wfdds818@6 wfdds820@8 wfdds822@10;
# i4 s4 | wfdds912@0 wfdds916@4 wfdds918@6 wfdds920@8 wfdds922@10;

# 抑郁轨迹
# i5 s5 | ces8sd12@0 ces8sd16*4 ces8sd18*6 ces8sd20*8 ces8sd22@10;

# ==============================================================================
# 0. 失访&插补&分析样本的描述性统计分析
# ==============================================================================
# Woods etal., (2024) Best practices for addressing missing data through multiple imputation
# Shi etal,. (2024) Supplementary Table 1.
# https://academic.oup.com/psychsocgerontology/article/79/9/gbae125/7717116?searchresult=1
# 
# age60+ 个体基本特征
# 
# 模型样本 个体基本特征 + 其他控制变量
# 
# 模型样本 个体基本特征 + 其他控制变量 + 无应答插补

### 生成 基期失访样本 分析样本 插补样本 对比表
# 参考了Woods etal.,2024(Best practices for addressing missing data through multiple imputation)
{
  # 确保已安装 compareGroups 包
  if (!require(compareGroups)) install.packages("compareGroups")
  library(compareGroups)
  
  ### 读取 "以2016年为基期2020年失访" 的数据
  lta_16a20_noresponse_dist <- haven::read_dta("C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/开题报告/0_data_clo/closeness&depression_descriptive_2012_2022.dta")
  names(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist)
  
  ### 合并插补数据集
  # 已知lgca_covar_MI_tics_data包含10个插补数据集, 请将10个数据集合并成1个, 变量名保持不变.
  merged_data <- do.call(rbind, lgca_covar_MI_tics_data) %>% 
    mutate(attrition_12_22 = 2) # 添加 attrition_12_22 列，值为2表示插补数据
  
  # 查看合并后的数据
  dim(merged_data)
  names(merged_data)
  
  # 1. 将 merged_data 的列名转换为小写
  names(merged_data) <- tolower(names(merged_data))
  
  # 2. 找出 lta_16a20_noresponse_dist 中缺失的列
  missing_cols <- setdiff(names(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist), names(merged_data))
  print("lta_16a20_noresponse_dist 中存在但 merged_data 中缺失的列:")
  print(missing_cols)
  
  # 3. 在 merged_data 中为缺失的列添加 NA 值
  for (col in missing_cols) {
    merged_data[[col]] <- NA
  }
  
  # 4. 按照 lta_16a20_noresponse_dist 的列顺序选择数据
  merged_data_subset <- merged_data[, names(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist), drop = FALSE]
  
  # 5. 合并数据
  lta_16a20_noresponse_dist <- rbind(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, 
                                     merged_data_subset)
  
  # 6. 查看结果
  print(paste("合并后总行数:", nrow(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist)))
  print(paste("合并后总列数:", ncol(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist)))
  table(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$wave)
  summary(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22)
  
  table(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22)
  # "Attrition" "Analytic sample" "MI sample"
  # 0     1     2 
  # 2186  3274 32740 
  
  # 查看lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$pinc12缺失值情况
  library(janitor)
  tab <- tabyl(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$pinc12)
  tab %>% adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 2)
  
  
  
  
  
  
  # 重申失访样本为因子变量, 添加值标签
  lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22 <- factor(
    lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22,
    levels = c(0, 1, 2),
    labels = c("失访样本", "分析样本", "插补样本")
  )
  
  
  # ## 声明以下变量为连续变量:
  # library(dplyr)
  # library(haven)
  # library(labelled) # 加载labelled包, 重新声明变量标签 
  # 
  # vars <- c(
  #   "wfd_m12","wfd_s12","wfd_d12","wfd_d112","wfd_d412",
  #   "ces812","ces2012","age12","pinc12","pinc212","adl12",
  #   "sat12","cdn12","cdar12","finc12","wave"
  # )
  # 
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$wfd_m12) <- "亲近度均值"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$wfd_s12) <- "亲近度标准差"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$wfd_d12) <- "亲近度性别差"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$wfd_d112) <- "亲近度排行差(老大)"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$wfd_d412) <- "亲近度排行差(长子)"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$ces812) <- "CESD-8"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$ces2012) <- "CESD-20"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$age12) <- "年龄"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$pinc12) <- "相对收入"

  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$adl12) <- "ADL得分"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$sat12) <- "生活满意度"
  # var_label(lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$cdn12) <- "子女数量"

  ## 挑选 2016年被解释变量 与 解释变量
  my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist <- lta_16a20_noresponse_dist %>% select(attrition_12_22, # 2016样本2020年失访
                                                                            
                                                                            wfd_m12, wfd_s12, wfd_d12, wfd_d112, wfd_d412, # 亲近度(60+ & 两个子女 & 亲近度有回答)
                                                                            ces812, ces2012, # 抑郁得分
                                                                            age12, sex12, edu12, hukou12, marr12, minor12, # 控制变量
                                                                            pinc12, pinc212, cores12, heal12, adl12, sat12, # (1)个体特征 
                                                                            cdn12, cdar12, cdsc12, eco12, hwc12, # (2)子女结构及互动
                                                                            urban12, finc12, prov12, # (3)家庭变量
                                                                            wave, noresponse12 # 补充变量
  )
  
  ## 定义"追访与失访"差异性检验
  dv <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ ces812+ces2012, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE) 
  iv <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ wfd_m12+wfd_s12+wfd_d12+wfd_d112+wfd_d412, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE)
  cpsn <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ age12+sex12+edu12+hukou12+marr12+minor12+pinc12+pinc212+cores12+heal12+adl12+sat12, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE)
  cprt <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ cdn12+cdar12+cdsc12+eco12+hwc12, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE)
  cfml <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ urban12+finc12+prov12+wave, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE)

  restab.dv <- createTable(dv, digits=c(ces812=3,ces2012=3), show.n=FALSE, show.all=FALSE, show.p.overall=FALSE, show.p.mul=TRUE, hide.no = "no")
  restab.iv <- createTable(iv, digits=c(wfd_m12=3,wfd_s12=3,wfd_d12=3,wfd_d112=3,wfd_d412=3), show.n=FALSE, show.all=FALSE, show.p.overall=FALSE, show.p.mul=TRUE, hide.no = "no")
  restab.cpsn <- createTable(cpsn, digits=c(age12=3,pinc12=3,pinc212=3,adl12=3,sat12=3), show.n=FALSE, show.all=FALSE, show.p.overall=FALSE, show.p.mul=TRUE, hide.no = "no")
  restab.cprt <- createTable(cprt, digits=c(cdn12=3,cdar12=3), show.n=FALSE, show.all=FALSE, show.p.overall=FALSE, show.p.mul=TRUE, hide.no = "no")

  # 按变量组 纵向合并
  restab <- rbind("被解释变量"=restab.dv, "解释变量"=restab.iv, 
                  "个体特征"=restab.cpsn, "子女结构"=restab.cprt, "家庭特征"=restab.cfml)
  
  # 展示 "追访&失访" 样本对比表
  print(restab, which.table='descr', 
        header.labels = c("p.overall" = "p-value"), nmax=TRUE, nmax.method = 1)
  
  # 导出 "追访&失访" 样本对比表
  filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
  export2word(restab, file=paste0(filepath,"closeness&depression_descriptive_2012_2022_1.docx"),
              which.table='descr', header.labels = c("p.overall" = "p-value"), nmax=TRUE)
  
  
  
  
  
  
  ### 生成 基期失访样本 分析样本 对比表 (删除失访样本后)
  # 查看原始数据
  table(my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22)
  unique(my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22)
  
  # 删除失访样本
  my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist <- my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist %>%
    filter(attrition_12_22 != "插补样本")
  
  # 删除未使用的因子水平
  my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22 <- droplevels(my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22)
  
  # 查看结果
  table(my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist$attrition_12_22)
  
  
  ## 定义"追访与失访"差异性检验
  dv <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ ces812+ces2012, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE) 
  iv <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ wfd_m12+wfd_s12+wfd_d12+wfd_d112+wfd_d412, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE)
  cpsn <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ age12+sex12+edu12+hukou12+marr12+minor12+pinc12+pinc212+cores12+heal12+adl12+sat12, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE)
  cprt <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ cdn12+cdar12+cdsc12+eco12+hwc12, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE)
  cfml <- compareGroups(attrition_12_22 ~ urban12+finc12+prov12+wave, data=my_data.lta_16a20_noresponse_dist, include.miss = FALSE, include.label = TRUE)
  
  restab.dv.miss <- missingTable(dv, show.p.overall=TRUE, show.p.mul=TRUE)
  restab.iv.miss <- missingTable(iv, show.p.overall=TRUE, show.p.mul=TRUE)
  restab.cpsn.miss <- missingTable(cpsn, show.p.overall=TRUE, show.p.mul=TRUE)
  restab.cprt.miss <- missingTable(cprt, show.p.overall=TRUE, show.p.mul=TRUE)
  restab.cfml.miss <- missingTable(cfml, show.p.overall=TRUE, show.p.mul=TRUE)
  
  # 按变量组 纵向合并
  restab.miss <- rbind("被解释变量"=restab.dv.miss, "解释变量"=restab.iv.miss, 
                       "个体特征"=restab.cpsn.miss, "子女结构"=restab.cprt.miss, "家庭特征"=restab.cfml.miss)
  
  # 展示 "追访&失访" 样本对比表
  print(restab.miss, which.table='descr', 
        header.labels = c("p.overall" = "p-value"), nmax=TRUE, nmax.method = 1)
  
  # 导出 "追访&失访" 样本对比表
  filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
  export2word(restab.miss, file=paste0(filepath,"closeness&depression_descriptive_2012_2022_2.docx"),
              which.table='descr', header.labels = c("p.overall" = "p-value"), nmax=TRUE)
  
}

# 主模型检验
### 直接效应估计(MI baseline TVCs & TICs)
{
  # nocontrolmean_r(二维平行过程LGCM,显著,选用)
  {
    # lcgm & MI 有外置插补(UG ex8.5)、内置插补(UG ex8.5)两种方式
    # 内置插补(UG ex8.5) 无法适用 "聚类标准误cluster", 故使用 外置插补(UG ex8.5)
    {
      
      # SD (nocontrolmean_r)
      # shape_level vs shape_level
      # 0. PP-LGCA_type1_nocontrolmean_r   基础模型(i显著i5 on i1 6.464, s显著s5 on s1 9.892)
      # 全部控制变量
      {
        pp_lgca <- mplusObject( 
          TITLE = glue(
            "Class-1_pp_LGCA"),
          
          VARIABLE = glue(
            "usevar = 
!wfdms12 wfdms16 wfdms18 wfdms20 wfdms22 
wfdcs12 wfdcs16 wfdcs18 wfdcs20 wfdcs22
!wfdds712 wfdds716 wfdds718 wfdds720 wfdds722

!!! time-invar

!marr20 eco202 eco203 hwc202 hwc203 hukou20 
!ageg22 pinc22 cores22 heal221 heal223 
!marr22 eco222 eco223 hwc222 hwc223 hukou22
;
idvariable=pid;
cluster=fid;"
          ),
          
          ANALYSIS =
            "estimator = mlr;
TYPE=COMPLEX;
!type = mixture;
!ALGORITHM=INTEGRATION;
!starts = 600 200;
!starts = 20;

processors = 10;

          MODEL = 
            "

!!! correlation among residual error terms of three indicators at each time point

!!! control: for long trend

! time-var
i5 s5 on ageg12 pinc12 pinc212 cores12 heal121 heal123;
i5 s5 on marr12 hukou12 eco122 eco123 hwc122 hwc123 sat12 adl12 finc12;

!!! control: for short trend
! coefficients were constrained to be equal over all waves
!ces8sd12 on ageg12 pincm112 pincm212 cores12 heal121 heal123 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd12 on marr12 hukou12 eco122 eco123 hwc122 hwc123 (p7-p12); 

!ces8sd14 on ageg14 pinc14 cores14 heal141 heal143 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd14 on marr14 hukou14 (p7-p8);

!!! FIML for missing data
!pincm112 pincm212 cdar12;

        pp_lgca_fit <- mplusModeler(pp_lgca,

    ### 直接效应做表(MI baseline TVCs & TICs)
    {
      library(dplyr)
      library(MplusAutomation)
      library(here)
      
      #Read all models for enumeration table
      #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
      here()
      filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
      
      ##### 读取所有模型结果
      ## 均值
      output.cesd8.type1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type1_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 方差
      output.cesd8.type2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type2_nocontrolmean_r_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 性别差
      output.cesd8.type3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type3_nocontrolmean_r_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差(老大)
      output.cesd8.type4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_nocontrolmean_r_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差(长子)
      output.cesd8.type5 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_4_nocontrolmean_r_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      
      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### 均值
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type1 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se)
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type1[["summaries"]]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("CFI=", sprintf("%.3f", CFI), ",\n TLI=", sprintf("%.3f", TLI), 
                                     ",\n RMSEA=", sprintf("%.3f", RMSEA))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type1 <- model.result.type1 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(I5_r2)),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(S5_r2))
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type1

          outcome.var = case_when(

            # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se)
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type3[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type3[["summaries"]]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]

      model.fit_text.type3 <- paste0("CFI=", sprintf("%.3f", CFI), ",\n TLI=", sprintf("%.3f", TLI), 
                                     ",\n RMSEA=", sprintf("%.3f", RMSEA))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type3 <- model.result.type3 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(I5_r2)),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(S5_r2))
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type3,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type3
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type3
      
      
      
      ### 排行差(老大)
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type4 <- output.cesd8.type4[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

            str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se)
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type4[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type4[["summaries"]]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type4 <- paste0("CFI=", sprintf("%.3f", CFI), ",\n TLI=", sprintf("%.3f", TLI), 
                                     ",\n RMSEA=", sprintf("%.3f", RMSEA))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type4 <- model.result.type4 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(I5_r2)),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(S5_r2))
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type4,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type4
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type4
      
      
      ### 排行差(长子)
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type5 <- output.cesd8.type5[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",

            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",

            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",

        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(I5_r2)),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(S5_r2))
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type4,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type4
        ) %>% 
        mutate(

            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",

      model.result.type1

      model.result.type14 <- model.result.type1 %>%

participated(Friedman etal., 2025). The variance of the slope for positive marital quality is constrained to be 0 due to lack of variation over time. <br>\n", 
                               "\\+ p < 0.1, * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001")),

    ### 直接效应做表(MI baseline TVCs & TICs)
    {
      library(dplyr)
      library(MplusAutomation)
      library(here)
      
      #Read all models for enumeration table
      #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
      here()
      filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
      
      ##### 读取所有模型结果
      ## 均值
      output.cesd8.type1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type1_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 方差
      output.cesd8.type2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type2_controlbaselinemean_r_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 性别差
      output.cesd8.type3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type3_controlbaselinemean_r_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差
      output.cesd8.type4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_controlbaselinemean_r_MI_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      
      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### 均值
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type1 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se)
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type1[["summaries"]]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("CFI=", sprintf("%.3f", CFI), ",\n TLI=", sprintf("%.3f", TLI), 
                                     ",\n RMSEA=", sprintf("%.3f", RMSEA))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type1 <- model.result.type1 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(I5_r2)),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(S5_r2))
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type1
      
      
      
      
      ### 标准差
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type2 <- output.cesd8.type2[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",

            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",

            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>%

        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se)
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square

      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]

i1 s1 | wfdms12@0 wfdms16*4 wfdms18*6 wfdms20*8 wfdms22@10;
!i2 s2 | wfdcs12@0 wfdcs16* wfdcs18* wfdcs20* wfdcs22@1; 
i3 s3 | wfdds712@0 wfdds716@4 wfdds718@6 wfdds720@8 wfdds722@10;  
!i4 s4 | wfdds812@0 wfdds816@4 wfdds818@6 wfdds820@8 wfdds822@10;
i5 s5 | ces8sd12@0 ces8sd16*4 ces8sd18*6 ces8sd20*8 ces8sd22@10;  
!s5@0;

!!! correlation among residual error terms of three indicators at each time point
!wfdms12 wfdcs12 wfdds712 wfdds812 WITH wfdms12 wfdcs12 wfdds712 wfdds812;
!wfdms16 wfdcs16 wfdds716 wfdds816 WITH wfdms16 wfdcs16 wfdds716 wfdds816;
!wfdms18 wfdcs18 wfdds718 wfdds818 WITH wfdms18 wfdcs18 wfdds718 wfdds818;

wfdms16 wfdds716 WITH wfdms16 wfdds716;
wfdms18 wfdds718 WITH wfdms18 wfdds718;
wfdms20 wfdds720 WITH wfdms20 wfdds720;
wfdms22 wfdds722 WITH wfdms22 wfdds722;

!*
!!! Focus: intercept of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
i5 on i3 ;

!!! Focus: slope of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
s5 on i3 s3 i5 ;

!!! control: for long trend
! time-invar
i5 s5 on sex12 edu12 urban12 prov122 prov123;
i5 s5 on cdn12 cdar12 cdsc121 cdsc122 minor12 wave ;

! time-var
i5 s5 on ageg12 pinc12 pinc212 cores12 heal121 heal123;

!!! control: for short trend
! coefficients were constrained to be equal over all waves

!ces8sd14 on ageg14 pinc14 cores14 heal141 heal143 (p1-p5);

      # 亲近度均值 对 满意度的影响，受到 性别的调节(i1sx_int on i 显著=0.250*, i1sx_int on s不显著, s1sx_int on s不显著)

    # depression
    {
      library(dplyr)
      library(MplusAutomation)
      library(here)
      
      #Read all models for enumeration table
      #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
      here()
      filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
      
      ##### 读取所有模型结果
      ## 均值
      output.cesd8.type1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type1_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_controlmean_r_step2.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 方差
      output.cesd8.type2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type2_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_controlmean_r_step2.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 性别差
      output.cesd8.type3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type3_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_controlmean_r_step2.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差
      output.cesd8.type4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_controlmean_r_step2.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      
      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### 均值
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type1 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WSI|WSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WII|WSI)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            # 如果param列满足"^(WSS)"则前三个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ 3,
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_LOW","S_LOW") ~ 6,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_HIGH","S_HIGH") ~ 7
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      model.result.type1
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type1[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]

      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                     ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type1 <- model.result.type1 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ "SEX",
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type1

          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WII|WSI)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),

            str_detect(param, "^(WSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(

participated(Friedman etal., 2025). The variance of the slope for positive marital quality is constrained to be 0 due to lack of variation over time. <br>\n",

          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WII") ~ "I5.ON",

            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"

            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",

          ),

  {
    ### 性别 的 调节效应做表
    # depression
    {
      library(dplyr)
      library(MplusAutomation)
      library(here)
      
      #Read all models for enumeration table
      #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
      here()
      filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
      
      ##### 读取所有模型结果
      ## 均值
      output.cesd8.type1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type1_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 方差
      output.cesd8.type2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type2_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 性别差
      output.cesd8.type3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type3_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差
      output.cesd8.type4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差(长子)
      output.cesd8.type5 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_4_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      
      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### 均值
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type1 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WSI|WSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WII|WSI)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            # 如果param列满足"^(WSS)"则前三个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ 3,
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_LOW","S_LOW") ~ 6,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_HIGH","S_HIGH") ~ 7
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      model.result.type1
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type1[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                     ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type1 <- model.result.type1 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ "SEX",
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type1
      
      
      
      
      ### 标准差

        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),

            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WII") ~ "I5.ON",

            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WII|WSI)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            # 如果param列满足"^(WSS)"则前三个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),

    ### 绘制简单斜率图
    {
      library(tidyverse)
      library(stringr)
      
      # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格
      parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
        if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
        if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
        
        is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
        
        # 提取数值部分
        coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
        value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
        value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
        
        return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig, raw = coef_part))
      }
      
      # 辅助函数：生成标签文本
      get_label_text <- function(raw_str) {
        if (is.na(raw_str)) return("")
        # 格式化：b = -0.304***
        return(paste0("b = ", raw_str))
      }
      
      # 2. 辅助函数：获取自定义轴标签名称
      get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
        if (type == "x") {
          # 横轴映射表
          labels <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code) # 默认返回原代码
        } else {
          # 纵轴映射表
          labels <- c(
            "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
            "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code)
        }
      }
      
      # 3. 辅助函数：绘制简单斜率图 (优化标签位置)
      generate_interaction_plot <- function(slope_low_val, slope_low_raw,
                                            slope_high_val, slope_high_raw,
                                            intercept_main_effect,
                                            x_code, y_code, title_suffix, filename) {
        
        # 定义预测变量 (X) 的范围
        x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
        
        # 获取自定义标签
        x_lab_text <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
        y_lab_text <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
        
        # --- 计算端点坐标 ---
        
        # Low Group (SEX = -1)
        b0_low <- 0 + (intercept_main_effect * -1)
        y_low_start <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_vals[1]
        y_low_end <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_vals[2]
        
        # High Group (SEX = 1)
        b0_high <- 0 + (intercept_main_effect * 1)
        y_high_start <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_vals[1]
        y_high_end <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_vals[2]
        
        # --- 构建绘图主数据 ---
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          x = rep(x_vals, 2),
          y = c(y_low_start, y_low_end, y_high_start, y_high_end),
          Group = rep(c("Low", "High"), each = 2)
        )
        
        # --- 构建标签数据 (策略性错开位置) ---
        x_pos_low <- -0.5
        y_pos_low <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_pos_low
        
        x_pos_high <- 0.5
        y_pos_high <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_pos_high
        
        label_data <- data.frame(
          x = c(x_pos_low, x_pos_high),
          y = c(y_pos_low, y_pos_high),
          Group = c("Low", "High"),
          Label = c(get_label_text(slope_low_raw), get_label_text(slope_high_raw))
        )
        
        # --- 绘图 ---
        p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Group, linetype = Group)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          
          # 添加文本标签 (带白色背景)
          geom_label(
            data = label_data,
            aes(label = Label),
            size = 3.5,
            label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
            label.size = 0,          # 无边框
            fill = "white",          # 白色背景
            alpha = 0.9,
            show.legend = FALSE
          ) +
          
          # 修改 legend 标签，加上 (SEX)
          scale_color_manual(
            values = c("Low" = "#377EB8", "High" = "#E41A1C"),
            labels = c("Low (SEX)", "High (SEX)")
          ) +
          scale_linetype_manual(
            values = c("solid", "longdash"),
            labels = c("Low (SEX)", "High (SEX)")
          ) +
          
          labs(
            x = x_lab_text,
            y = y_lab_text
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "inside",
            legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
            legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
            legend.box.just = "right",
            legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid = element_blank()
          )
        
        ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
        message(paste(" -> Saved plot:", filename))
      }
      
      # 4. 主循环（完全不变）
      data_list <- list(
        type1 = model.result.type1,
        type2 = model.result.type2,
        type3 = model.result.type3,
        type4 = model.result.type4,
        type5 = model.result.type5
      )
      
      for (name in names(data_list)) {
        df <- data_list[[name]]
        message(paste("Processing:", name))
        
        # 寻找调节变量 SEX 的主效应行
        pinc_row <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "^SEX"))
        
        # 查找所有显著的交互项行
        int_rows <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "_INT"))
        
        filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                          "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        
        if (nrow(int_rows) > 0) {
          for (i in 1:nrow(int_rows)) {
            row_data <- int_rows[i, ]
            var_name <- row_data$predictor.var
            
            # 提取交互项的前两个字母作为 x_label
            x_label_prefix <- str_sub(var_name, 1, 2)
            
            # 判断交互项类型
            is_I_interaction <- str_starts(var_name, "I")
            
            # CASE A: I5.ON (截距)
            res_i5 <- parse_cell(row_data$I5.ON)
            if (res_i5$is_sig) {
              
              if (is_I_interaction) {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_LOW") %>% pull(I5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_HIGH") %>% pull(I5.ON))
              } else {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_LOW") %>% pull(I5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_HIGH") %>% pull(I5.ON))
              }
              
              pinc_main <- if(nrow(pinc_row) > 0) parse_cell(pinc_row$I5.ON)$value else 0
              
              message(paste(" -> Significant Interaction on I5:", var_name))
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low_val = low_obj$value, slope_low_raw = low_obj$raw,
                slope_high_val = high_obj$value, slope_high_raw = high_obj$raw,
                intercept_main_effect = pinc_main,
                x_code = x_label_prefix,
                y_code = "I5",
                title_suffix = paste(name, var_name, "on I5"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix,"/SimpleSlope_SEX_", name, "_", var_name, "_on_I5.svg")
              )
            }
            
            # CASE B: S5.ON (斜率)
            res_s5 <- parse_cell(row_data$S5.ON)
            if (res_s5$is_sig) {
              
              if (is_I_interaction) {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_LOW") %>% pull(S5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_HIGH") %>% pull(S5.ON))
              } else {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_LOW") %>% pull(S5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_HIGH") %>% pull(S5.ON))
              }
              
              pinc_main <- if(nrow(pinc_row) > 0) parse_cell(pinc_row$S5.ON)$value else 0
              
              message(paste(" -> Significant Interaction on S5:", var_name))
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low_val = low_obj$value, slope_low_raw = low_obj$raw,
                slope_high_val = high_obj$value, slope_high_raw = high_obj$raw,
                intercept_main_effect = pinc_main,
                x_code = x_label_prefix,
                y_code = "S5",
                title_suffix = paste(name, var_name, "on S5"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix,"/SimpleSlope_SEX_", name, "_", var_name, "_on_S5.svg")
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    {
      library(dplyr)
      library(MplusAutomation)
      library(here)
      
      #Read all models for enumeration table
      #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
      here()
      filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
      
      ##### 读取所有模型结果
      ## 均值
      output.cesd8.type1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type1_edu_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 方差
      output.cesd8.type2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type2_edu_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 性别差
      output.cesd8.type3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type3_edu_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差
      output.cesd8.type4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_edu_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差(长子)
      output.cesd8.type5 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_4_edu_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      
      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### 均值
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type1 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WSI|WSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WII|WSI)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            # 如果param列满足"^(WSS)"则前三个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 edu11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("EDU12") ~ 3,
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_LOW","S_LOW") ~ 6,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_HIGH","S_HIGH") ~ 7
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type1[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                     ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type1 <- model.result.type1 %>%

          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",

        ) %>%

          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var %in% c("EDU12") ~ "EDU",
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "EDU × Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "EDU × Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))

          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>%
