    ### 绘制简单斜率图
    {
      library(tidyverse)
      library(stringr)
      
      # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格
      parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
        if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
        if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
        
        is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
        
        # 提取数值部分
        coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
        value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
        value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
        
        return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig, raw = coef_part))
      }
      
      # 辅助函数：生成标签文本
      get_label_text <- function(raw_str) {
        if (is.na(raw_str)) return("")
        # 格式化：b = -0.304***
        return(paste0("b = ", raw_str))
      }
      
      # 2. 辅助函数：获取自定义轴标签名称
      get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
        if (type == "x") {
          # 横轴映射表
          labels <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code) # 默认返回原代码
        } else {
          # 纵轴映射表
          labels <- c(
            "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
            "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code)
        }
      }
      
      # 3. 辅助函数：绘制简单斜率图 (优化标签位置)
      generate_interaction_plot <- function(slope_low_val, slope_low_raw,
                                            slope_high_val, slope_high_raw,
                                            intercept_main_effect,
                                            x_code, y_code, title_suffix, filename) {
        
        # 定义预测变量 (X) 的范围
        x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
        
        # 获取自定义标签
        x_lab_text <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
        y_lab_text <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
        
        # --- 计算端点坐标 ---
        
        # Low Group (EDU = -1)
        b0_low <- 0 + (intercept_main_effect * -1)
        y_low_start <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_vals[1]
        y_low_end <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_vals[2]
        
        # High Group (EDU = 1)
        b0_high <- 0 + (intercept_main_effect * 1)
        y_high_start <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_vals[1]
        y_high_end <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_vals[2]
        
        # --- 构建绘图主数据 ---
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          x = rep(x_vals, 2),
          y = c(y_low_start, y_low_end, y_high_start, y_high_end),
          Group = rep(c("Low", "High"), each = 2)
        )
        
        # --- 构建标签数据 (策略性错开位置) ---
        x_pos_low <- -0.5
        y_pos_low <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_pos_low
        
        x_pos_high <- 0.5
        y_pos_high <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_pos_high
        
        label_data <- data.frame(
          x = c(x_pos_low, x_pos_high),
          y = c(y_pos_low, y_pos_high),
          Group = c("Low", "High"),
          Label = c(get_label_text(slope_low_raw), get_label_text(slope_high_raw))
        )
        
        # --- 绘图 ---
        p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Group, linetype = Group)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          
          # 添加文本标签 (带白色背景)
          geom_label(
            data = label_data,
            aes(label = Label),
            size = 3.5,
            label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
            label.size = 0,          # 无边框
            fill = "white",          # 白色背景
            alpha = 0.9,
            show.legend = FALSE
          ) +
          
          # 修改 legend 标签，加上 (EDU)
          scale_color_manual(
            values = c("Low" = "#377EB8", "High" = "#E41A1C"),
            labels = c("Low (EDU)", "High (EDU)")
          ) +
          scale_linetype_manual(
            values = c("solid", "longdash"),
            labels = c("Low (EDU)", "High (EDU)")
          ) +
          
          labs(
            x = x_lab_text,
            y = y_lab_text
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "inside",
            legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
            legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
            legend.box.just = "right",
            legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid = element_blank()
          )
        
        ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
        message(paste(" -> Saved plot:", filename))
      }
      
      # 4. 主循环（完全不变）
      data_list <- list(
        type1 = model.result.type1,
        type2 = model.result.type2,
        type3 = model.result.type3,
        type4 = model.result.type4,
        type5 = model.result.type5
      )
      
      for (name in names(data_list)) {
        df <- data_list[[name]]
        message(paste("Processing:", name))
        
        # 寻找调节变量 EDU 的主效应行
        pinc_row <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "^EDU"))
        
        # 查找所有显著的交互项行
        int_rows <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "_INT"))
        
        filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                          "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        
        if (nrow(int_rows) > 0) {
          for (i in 1:nrow(int_rows)) {
            row_data <- int_rows[i, ]
            var_name <- row_data$predictor.var
            
            # 提取交互项的前两个字母作为 x_label
            x_label_prefix <- str_sub(var_name, 1, 2)
            
            # 判断交互项类型
            is_I_interaction <- str_starts(var_name, "I")
            
            # CASE A: I5.ON (截距)
            res_i5 <- parse_cell(row_data$I5.ON)
            if (res_i5$is_sig) {
              
              if (is_I_interaction) {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_LOW") %>% pull(I5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_HIGH") %>% pull(I5.ON))
              } else {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_LOW") %>% pull(I5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_HIGH") %>% pull(I5.ON))
              }
              
              pinc_main <- if(nrow(pinc_row) > 0) parse_cell(pinc_row$I5.ON)$value else 0
              
              message(paste(" -> Significant Interaction on I5:", var_name))
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low_val = low_obj$value, slope_low_raw = low_obj$raw,
                slope_high_val = high_obj$value, slope_high_raw = high_obj$raw,
                intercept_main_effect = pinc_main,
                x_code = x_label_prefix,
                y_code = "I5",
                title_suffix = paste(name, var_name, "on I5"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix,"/SimpleSlope_EDU_", name, "_", var_name, "_on_I5.svg")
              )
            }
            
            # CASE B: S5.ON (斜率)
            res_s5 <- parse_cell(row_data$S5.ON)
            if (res_s5$is_sig) {
              
              if (is_I_interaction) {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_LOW") %>% pull(S5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_HIGH") %>% pull(S5.ON))
              } else {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_LOW") %>% pull(S5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_HIGH") %>% pull(S5.ON))
              }
              
              pinc_main <- if(nrow(pinc_row) > 0) parse_cell(pinc_row$S5.ON)$value else 0
              
              message(paste(" -> Significant Interaction on S5:", var_name))
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low_val = low_obj$value, slope_low_raw = low_obj$raw,
                slope_high_val = high_obj$value, slope_high_raw = high_obj$raw,
                intercept_main_effect = pinc_main,
                x_code = x_label_prefix,
                y_code = "S5",
                title_suffix = paste(name, var_name, "on S5"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix,"/SimpleSlope_EDU_", name, "_", var_name, "_on_S5.svg")
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

      ##### 读取所有模型结果

      ## 方差

      ## 性别差

      ## 排行差
      output.cesd8.type4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_urban_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      ## 排行差(长子)
      output.cesd8.type5 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"c_pp_lgca_type4_4_urban_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.out"), quiet = TRUE)
      
      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### 均值
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type1 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WSI|WSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WII|WSI)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            # 如果param列满足"^(WSS)"则前三个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 urban11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT

            predictor.var %in% c("I_HIGH","S_HIGH") ~ 7
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)

            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 urban11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("URBAN12") ~ 3,
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_LOW","S_LOW") ~ 6,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_HIGH","S_HIGH") ~ 7
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type4[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type4[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type4 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                     ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))

        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",

        ) %>%

          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type4,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type4
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var %in% c("URBAN12") ~ "URBAN",
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "URBAN × Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "URBAN × Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type4
      
      
      ### 排行差(长子)
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type5 <- output.cesd8.type5[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WSI|WSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WII|WSI)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            # 如果param列满足"^(WSS)"则前三个字符替换为"S"
            str_detect(param, "^(WSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>%

          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 urban11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT

            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,

            predictor.var %in% c("I_HIGH","S_HIGH") ~ 7
          )
        ) %>%

        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type5[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type5[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]

                                     ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))

      model.result.type5 <- model.result.type5 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),

        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type5,

          predictor.var.common = case_when(

            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var %in% c("URBAN12") ~ "URBAN",
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "URBAN × Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "URBAN × Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",

      model.result.type5
      
      
      
      model.result.type1
      model.result.type2
      model.result.type3
      model.result.type4
      model.result.type5
      
      
      ##### 合并所有结果表
      # 按predictor.var列合并所有结果到一个数据框
      library(dplyr)
      
      # 方案1：逐步合并，每次都明确指定 suffix
      model.result.type14 <- model.result.type1 %>%
        select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
        rename(I5.ON.type1 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type1 = S5.ON) %>%
        full_join(
          model.result.type2 %>%
            select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
            rename(I5.ON.type2 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type2 = S5.ON),
          by = "predictor.var.common"
        ) %>%
        full_join(
          model.result.type3 %>%
            select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
            rename(I5.ON.type3 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type3 = S5.ON),
          by = "predictor.var.common"
        ) %>%
        full_join(
          model.result.type4 %>%
            select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
            rename(I5.ON.type4 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type4 = S5.ON),
          by = "predictor.var.common"
        ) %>%
        full_join(
          model.result.type5 %>%
            select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
            rename(I5.ON.type5 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type5 = S5.ON),
          by = "predictor.var.common"
        )
      
      # 查看结果(带控制变量)
      model.result.type14
      
      
      
      model.result.type14.simple <- model.result.type14 %>%
        filter(predictor.var.common %in% c("Intercept","Slope","Means","URBAN" ,"URBAN × Intercept","URBAN × Slope","Variances","Pseudo-R²","Model fit index","I_LOW","S_LOW","I_HIGH","S_HIGH")) %>% 
        # 将所有缺失值 NA 替换为 "-"
        mutate(
          across(everything(), as.character),  # 将所有列转换为字符型
          across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "— —", .))
        )

      model.result.type14.simple

        tab_footnote(

Unstandardized coeffcients are presented. Standard errors in parentheses. All models were also adjusted for number of waves in which respondents 
participated(Friedman etal., 2025). The variance of the slope for positive marital quality is constrained to be 0 due to lack of variation over time. <br>\n", 
                               "\\+ p < 0.1, * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001")),
          locations = cells_body(columns = "I5.ON.type1",
                                 rows = 1)
        ) %>% gt::fmt_markdown(columns = everything())

    ### 绘制简单斜率图
    {
      library(tidyverse)
      library(stringr)
      
      # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格
      parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
        if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
        if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
        
        is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
        
        # 提取数值部分
        coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
        value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
        value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
        
        return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig, raw = coef_part))
      }
      
      # 辅助函数：生成标签文本
      get_label_text <- function(raw_str) {
        if (is.na(raw_str)) return("")
        # 格式化：b = -0.304***
        return(paste0("b = ", raw_str))
      }
      
      # 2. 辅助函数：获取自定义轴标签名称
      get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
        if (type == "x") {
          # 横轴映射表
          labels <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code) # 默认返回原代码
        } else {
          # 纵轴映射表
          labels <- c(
            "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
            "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code)
        }
      }
      
      # 3. 辅助函数：绘制简单斜率图 (优化标签位置)
      generate_interaction_plot <- function(slope_low_val, slope_low_raw,
                                            slope_high_val, slope_high_raw,
                                            intercept_main_effect,
                                            x_code, y_code, title_suffix, filename) {
        
        # 定义预测变量 (X) 的范围
        x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
        
        # 获取自定义标签
        x_lab_text <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
        y_lab_text <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
        
        # --- 计算端点坐标 ---
        
        # Low Group (URBAN = -1)
        b0_low <- 0 + (intercept_main_effect * -1)
        y_low_start <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_vals[1]
        y_low_end <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_vals[2]
        
        # High Group (URBAN = 1)
        b0_high <- 0 + (intercept_main_effect * 1)
        y_high_start <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_vals[1]
        y_high_end <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_vals[2]
        
        # --- 构建绘图主数据 ---
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          x = rep(x_vals, 2),
          y = c(y_low_start, y_low_end, y_high_start, y_high_end),
          Group = rep(c("Low", "High"), each = 2)
        )
        
        # --- 构建标签数据 (策略性错开位置) ---
        x_pos_low <- -0.5
        y_pos_low <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_pos_low
        
        x_pos_high <- 0.5
        y_pos_high <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_pos_high
        
        label_data <- data.frame(
          x = c(x_pos_low, x_pos_high),
          y = c(y_pos_low, y_pos_high),
          Group = c("Low", "High"),
          Label = c(get_label_text(slope_low_raw), get_label_text(slope_high_raw))
        )
        
        # --- 绘图 ---
        p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Group, linetype = Group)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          
          # 添加文本标签 (带白色背景)
          geom_label(
            data = label_data,
            aes(label = Label),
            size = 3.5,
            label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
            label.size = 0,          # 无边框
            fill = "white",          # 白色背景
            alpha = 0.9,
            show.legend = FALSE
          ) +
          
          # 修改 legend 标签，加上 (URBAN)
          scale_color_manual(
            values = c("Low" = "#377EB8", "High" = "#E41A1C"),
            labels = c("Low (RURAL)", "High (URBAN)")
          ) +
          scale_linetype_manual(
            values = c("solid", "longdash"),
            labels = c("Low (RURAL)", "High (URBAN)")
          ) +
          
          labs(
            x = x_lab_text,
            y = y_lab_text
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "inside",
            legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
            legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
            legend.box.just = "right",
            legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid = element_blank()
          )
        
        ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
        message(paste(" -> Saved plot:", filename))
      }
      
      # 4. 主循环（完全不变）
      data_list <- list(
        type1 = model.result.type1,
        type2 = model.result.type2,
        type3 = model.result.type3,
        type4 = model.result.type4,
        type5 = model.result.type5
      )
      
      for (name in names(data_list)) {
        df <- data_list[[name]]
        message(paste("Processing:", name))
        
        # 寻找调节变量 URBAN 的主效应行
        pinc_row <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "^URBAN"))
        
        # 查找所有显著的交互项行
        int_rows <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "_INT"))
        
        filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                          "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        
        if (nrow(int_rows) > 0) {
          for (i in 1:nrow(int_rows)) {
            row_data <- int_rows[i, ]
            var_name <- row_data$predictor.var
            
            # 提取交互项的前两个字母作为 x_label
            x_label_prefix <- str_sub(var_name, 1, 2)
            
            # 判断交互项类型
            is_I_interaction <- str_starts(var_name, "I")
            
            # CASE A: I5.ON (截距)
            res_i5 <- parse_cell(row_data$I5.ON)
            if (res_i5$is_sig) {
              
              if (is_I_interaction) {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_LOW") %>% pull(I5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_HIGH") %>% pull(I5.ON))
              } else {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_LOW") %>% pull(I5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_HIGH") %>% pull(I5.ON))
              }
              
              pinc_main <- if(nrow(pinc_row) > 0) parse_cell(pinc_row$I5.ON)$value else 0
              
              message(paste(" -> Significant Interaction on I5:", var_name))
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low_val = low_obj$value, slope_low_raw = low_obj$raw,
                slope_high_val = high_obj$value, slope_high_raw = high_obj$raw,
                intercept_main_effect = pinc_main,
                x_code = x_label_prefix,
                y_code = "I5",
                title_suffix = paste(name, var_name, "on I5"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix,"/SimpleSlope_URBAN_", name, "_", var_name, "_on_I5.svg")
              )
            }
            
            # CASE B: S5.ON (斜率)
            res_s5 <- parse_cell(row_data$S5.ON)
            if (res_s5$is_sig) {
              
              if (is_I_interaction) {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_LOW") %>% pull(S5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_HIGH") %>% pull(S5.ON))
              } else {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_LOW") %>% pull(S5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_HIGH") %>% pull(S5.ON))
              }
              
              pinc_main <- if(nrow(pinc_row) > 0) parse_cell(pinc_row$S5.ON)$value else 0
              
              message(paste(" -> Significant Interaction on S5:", var_name))
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low_val = low_obj$value, slope_low_raw = low_obj$raw,
                slope_high_val = high_obj$value, slope_high_raw = high_obj$raw,
                intercept_main_effect = pinc_main,
                x_code = x_label_prefix,
                y_code = "S5",
                title_suffix = paste(name, var_name, "on S5"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix,"/SimpleSlope_URBAN_", name, "_", var_name, "_on_S5.svg")
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

      ##### 制表模型结果
      ### 均值
      # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
      model.result.type1 <- output.cesd8.type1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
        mutate(
          across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
          outcome.var = case_when(
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WII") ~ "I5.ON",
            paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
            paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WSI|WSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
            TRUE ~ paramHeader
          ),
          predictor.var = case_when(
            paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
            paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
            # 如果param列满足"^(WII|WSI)"则前三个字符替换为"I"
            str_detect(param, "^(WII|WSI)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),

            str_detect(param, "^(WSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 4, nchar(param))),
            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 pinc11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT

            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ 5,

            predictor.var %in% c("I_HIGH","S_HIGH") ~ 7
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)

            TRUE ~ param
          ),
          sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                               sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
        ) %>% 
        filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
        select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
        mutate(
          # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 pinc11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
          sort_group = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,
            predictor.var %in% c("PINC412") ~ 3,
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ 4,
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ 5,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_LOW","S_LOW") ~ 6,
            predictor.var %in% c("I_HIGH","S_HIGH") ~ 7
          )
        ) %>% 
        # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
        arrange(sort_group) %>% 
        select(-sort_group)
      
      # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
      r2 <- output.cesd8.type5[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
      I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
      S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
      
      # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
      summaries <- output.cesd8.type5[["summaries"]]
      AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
      BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
      CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
      TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
      RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
      
      # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
      model.fit_text.type5 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                     ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
      
      # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
      model.result.type5 <- model.result.type5 %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
          I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),
          S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
        ) %>% 
        add_row(
          predictor.var = "Model fit index",
          I5.ON = model.fit_text.type5,
          S5.ON = model.fit_text.type5
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          predictor.var.common = case_when(
            predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
            predictor.var %in% c("PINC412") ~ "PINC",
            predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "PINC × Intercept",
            predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "PINC × Slope",
            predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
            predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
            TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
          ))
      
      model.result.type5
      
      
      
      model.result.type1
      model.result.type2
      model.result.type3
      model.result.type4
      model.result.type5
      
      
      ##### 合并所有结果表
      # 按predictor.var列合并所有结果到一个数据框
      library(dplyr)
      
      # 方案1：逐步合并，每次都明确指定 suffix
      model.result.type14 <- model.result.type1 %>%
        select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
        rename(I5.ON.type1 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type1 = S5.ON) %>%
        full_join(
          model.result.type2 %>%
            select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
            rename(I5.ON.type2 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type2 = S5.ON),
          by = "predictor.var.common"
        ) %>%
        full_join(
          model.result.type3 %>%
            select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
            rename(I5.ON.type3 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type3 = S5.ON),
          by = "predictor.var.common"
        ) %>%
        full_join(
          model.result.type4 %>%
            select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
            rename(I5.ON.type4 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type4 = S5.ON),
          by = "predictor.var.common"
        ) %>%
        full_join(
          model.result.type5 %>%
            select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%
            rename(I5.ON.type5 = I5.ON, S5.ON.type5 = S5.ON),
          by = "predictor.var.common"
        )
      
      # 查看结果(带控制变量)
      model.result.type14
      
      
      
      model.result.type14.simple <- model.result.type14 %>%
        filter(predictor.var.common %in% c("Intercept","Slope","Means","PINC" ,"PINC × Intercept","PINC × Slope","Variances","Pseudo-R²","Model fit index","I_LOW","S_LOW","I_HIGH","S_HIGH")) %>% 
        # 将所有缺失值 NA 替换为 "-"
        mutate(
          across(everything(), as.character),  # 将所有列转换为字符型
          across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "— —", .))
        ) 
      
      # 查看结果(略控制变量)
      model.result.type14.simple
      
      
      
      
      ##### 使用gt()包导出表格
      model.result.type14.simple.t <- model.result.type14.simple %>%
        gt(rowname_col = "predictor.var.common",) %>%
        # tab_options(
        #   table.font.size = px(12),
        #   row_group.as_column = FALSE
        # ) %>% 
        tab_header(
          title = md("PP-LGCM moderation effects of contaction traj on depressive traj_MI_TICs_nocontrolmean_r"),
          subtitle = md("")) %>%
        cols_label(
          predictor.var.common = md(""),
          "I5.ON.type1" = md("**I**"),
          "S5.ON.type1" = md("**S**"),
          "I5.ON.type2" = md("**I**"),
          "S5.ON.type2" = md("**S**"),
          "I5.ON.type3" = md("**I**"),
          "S5.ON.type3" = md("**S**"),
          "I5.ON.type4" = md("**I**"),
          "S5.ON.type4" = md("**S**"),
          "I5.ON.type5" = md("**I**"),
          "S5.ON.type5" = md("**S**")
        ) %>% 
        tab_spanner(label = "Mean", columns = 2:3) %>% 
        tab_spanner(label = "SD", columns = 4:5) %>% 
        tab_spanner(label = "Gender_diff", columns = 6:7) %>% 
        tab_spanner(label = "Sibling_diff", columns = 8:9) %>% 
        tab_spanner(label = "Sibling_diff4", columns = 10:11) %>% 
        tab_style(
          style = cell_text(align = "center", whitespace = "pre-wrap"),
          locations = cells_body(columns = c(2:11))  # c(亲密无间型,生活照料型,经济帮助型,独立疏远型)
        )  %>%
        tab_style(
          style = cell_text(weight = "bold",),
          locations = cells_row_groups()
        )  %>%
        tab_footnote( 
          footnote = md(paste0("Notes . CFI = comparative fit index; RMSEA = root mean square error of approximation. All the control variables were included in both models. Unstandardized coeffcients are presented. Standard errors in parentheses. All models were also adjusted for number of waves in which respondents 
participated(Friedman etal., 2025). The variance of the slope for positive marital quality is constrained to be 0 due to lack of variation over time. <br>\n", 
                               "\\+ p < 0.1, * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001")),
          locations = cells_body(columns = "I5.ON.type1",
                                 rows = 1)
        ) %>% gt::fmt_markdown(columns = everything()) 
      
      print(model.result.type14.simple.t) 
      
      # 覆盖已有文件时会报错(加入if函数提前删除重复文件，避免报错)

                                     "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22",

      filename.png <- file.path(here("interge_rela",

    ### 绘制简单斜率图
    {
      library(tidyverse)
      library(stringr)
      
      # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格
      parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
        if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
        if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
        
        is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
        
        # 提取数值部分
        coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
        value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
        value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
        
        return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig, raw = coef_part))
      }
      
      # 辅助函数：生成标签文本
      get_label_text <- function(raw_str) {
        if (is.na(raw_str)) return("")
        # 格式化：b = -0.304***
        return(paste0("b = ", raw_str))
      }
      
      # 2. 辅助函数：获取自定义轴标签名称
      get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
        if (type == "x") {
          # 横轴映射表
          labels <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code) # 默认返回原代码
        } else {
          # 纵轴映射表
          labels <- c(
            "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
            "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
          )
          if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
          return(code)
        }
      }
      
      # 3. 辅助函数：绘制简单斜率图 (优化标签位置)
      generate_interaction_plot <- function(slope_low_val, slope_low_raw,
                                            slope_high_val, slope_high_raw,
                                            intercept_main_effect,
                                            x_code, y_code, title_suffix, filename) {
        
        # 定义预测变量 (X) 的范围
        x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
        
        # 获取自定义标签
        x_lab_text <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
        y_lab_text <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
        
        # --- 计算端点坐标 ---
        
        # Low Group (PINC = -1)
        b0_low <- 0 + (intercept_main_effect * -1)
        y_low_start <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_vals[1]
        y_low_end <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_vals[2]
        
        # High Group (PINC = 1)
        b0_high <- 0 + (intercept_main_effect * 1)
        y_high_start <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_vals[1]
        y_high_end <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_vals[2]
        
        # --- 构建绘图主数据 ---
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          x = rep(x_vals, 2),
          y = c(y_low_start, y_low_end, y_high_start, y_high_end),
          Group = rep(c("Low", "High"), each = 2)
        )
        
        # --- 构建标签数据 (策略性错开位置) ---
        x_pos_low <- -0.5
        y_pos_low <- b0_low + slope_low_val * x_pos_low
        
        x_pos_high <- 0.5
        y_pos_high <- b0_high + slope_high_val * x_pos_high
        
        label_data <- data.frame(
          x = c(x_pos_low, x_pos_high),
          y = c(y_pos_low, y_pos_high),
          Group = c("Low", "High"),
          Label = c(get_label_text(slope_low_raw), get_label_text(slope_high_raw))
        )
        
        # --- 绘图 ---
        p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Group, linetype = Group)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          
          # 添加文本标签 (带白色背景)
          geom_label(
            data = label_data,
            aes(label = Label),
            size = 3.5,
            label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
            label.size = 0,          # 无边框
            fill = "white",          # 白色背景
            alpha = 0.9,
            show.legend = FALSE
          ) +
          
          # 修改 legend 标签，加上 (PINC)
          scale_color_manual(
            values = c("Low" = "#377EB8", "High" = "#E41A1C"),
            labels = c("Low (PINC)", "High (PINC)")
          ) +
          scale_linetype_manual(
            values = c("solid", "longdash"),
            labels = c("Low (PINC)", "High (PINC)")
          ) +
          
          labs(
            x = x_lab_text,
            y = y_lab_text
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "inside",
            legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
            legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
            legend.box.just = "right",
            legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid = element_blank()
          )
        
        ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
        message(paste(" -> Saved plot:", filename))
      }
      
      # 4. 主循环（完全不变）
      data_list <- list(
        type1 = model.result.type1,
        type2 = model.result.type2,
        type3 = model.result.type3,
        type4 = model.result.type4,
        type5 = model.result.type5
      )
      
      for (name in names(data_list)) {
        df <- data_list[[name]]
        message(paste("Processing:", name))
        
        # 寻找调节变量 PINC 的主效应行
        pinc_row <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "^PINC"))
        
        # 查找所有显著的交互项行
        int_rows <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "_INT"))
        
        filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                          "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        
        if (nrow(int_rows) > 0) {
          for (i in 1:nrow(int_rows)) {
            row_data <- int_rows[i, ]
            var_name <- row_data$predictor.var
            
            # 提取交互项的前两个字母作为 x_label
            x_label_prefix <- str_sub(var_name, 1, 2)
            
            # 判断交互项类型
            is_I_interaction <- str_starts(var_name, "I")
            
            # CASE A: I5.ON (截距)
            res_i5 <- parse_cell(row_data$I5.ON)
            if (res_i5$is_sig) {
              
              if (is_I_interaction) {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_LOW") %>% pull(I5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_HIGH") %>% pull(I5.ON))
              } else {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_LOW") %>% pull(I5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_HIGH") %>% pull(I5.ON))
              }
              
              pinc_main <- if(nrow(pinc_row) > 0) parse_cell(pinc_row$I5.ON)$value else 0
              
              message(paste(" -> Significant Interaction on I5:", var_name))
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low_val = low_obj$value, slope_low_raw = low_obj$raw,
                slope_high_val = high_obj$value, slope_high_raw = high_obj$raw,
                intercept_main_effect = pinc_main,
                x_code = x_label_prefix,
                y_code = "I5",
                title_suffix = paste(name, var_name, "on I5"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix,"/SimpleSlope_PINC_", name, "_", var_name, "_on_I5.svg")
              )
            }
            
            # CASE B: S5.ON (斜率)
            res_s5 <- parse_cell(row_data$S5.ON)
            if (res_s5$is_sig) {
              
              if (is_I_interaction) {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_LOW") %>% pull(S5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "I_HIGH") %>% pull(S5.ON))
              } else {
                low_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_LOW") %>% pull(S5.ON))
                high_obj <- parse_cell(df %>% filter(predictor.var == "S_HIGH") %>% pull(S5.ON))
              }
              
              pinc_main <- if(nrow(pinc_row) > 0) parse_cell(pinc_row$S5.ON)$value else 0
              
              message(paste(" -> Significant Interaction on S5:", var_name))
              generate_interaction_plot(
                slope_low_val = low_obj$value, slope_low_raw = low_obj$raw,
                slope_high_val = high_obj$value, slope_high_raw = high_obj$raw,
                intercept_main_effect = pinc_main,
                x_code = x_label_prefix,
                y_code = "S5",
                title_suffix = paste(name, var_name, "on S5"),
                filename = paste0(filename_prefix,"/SimpleSlope_PINC_", name, "_", var_name, "_on_S5.svg")
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  ##### bianry：直接效应异质性估计的似然比检验Likelyhood Ratio Test(Maslowsky & Ozer, 2014)
  {
    ##### 性别 的 调节效应(无显著的交互项, 无需检验)

      # 亲近度均值 对 满意度的影响，受到 性别的调节(i1sx_int on i 显著=0.250*, i1sx_int on s不显著, s1sx_int on s不显著)
      # edu MOD intercept & edu MOD slope

      {

i5 s5 | ces8sd12@0 ces8sd16*4 ces8sd18*6 ces8sd20*8 ces8sd22@10;

!wfdms16 wfdcs16 wfdds716 wfdds816 WITH wfdms16 wfdcs16 wfdds716 wfdds816;
!wfdms18 wfdcs18 wfdds718 wfdds818 WITH wfdms18 wfdcs18 wfdds718 wfdds818;

    ##### 结果整理  
    library(MplusAutomation)
    library(tidyverse)
    library(stringr)
    
    # 1.定义辅助函数：从compareModels输出中提取LRT统计量
    extract_lrt_info <- function(model0, model1, imputation_num) {
      # 捕获compareModels()的控制台输出
      output <- capture.output(
        compareModels(model0, model1,
                      show = c("summaries"),
                      equalityMargin = c(param = .05, pvalue = .02),
                      sort = "type", diffTest = TRUE, showNS = FALSE)
      )
      
      # 解析LRT统计量、自由度和p值
      lrt_stat <- NA
      df <- NA
      p_value <- NA
      
      # 查找包含 "Chi-square difference:" 的行
      chi_line <- grep("Chi-square difference:", output, value = TRUE)
      if (length(chi_line) > 0) {
        # 提取冒号后的所有内容，然后提取数字（包括负号）
        chi_str <- str_trim(str_extract(chi_line[1], ":\\s*(-?[0-9.]+)"))
        lrt_stat <- as.numeric(str_extract(chi_str, "-?[0-9.]+"))
      }
      
      # 查找包含 "Diff degrees of freedom:" 的行
      df_line <- grep("Diff degrees of freedom:", output, value = TRUE)
      if (length(df_line) > 0) {
        df_str <- str_trim(str_extract(df_line[1], ":\\s*([0-9]+)"))
        df <- as.numeric(str_extract(df_str, "[0-9]+"))
      }
      
      # 查找包含 "P-value:" 的行
      p_line <- grep("P-value:", output, value = TRUE)
      if (length(p_line) > 0) {
        p_str <- str_trim(str_extract(p_line[1], ":\\s*([0-9.]+)"))
        p_value <- as.numeric(str_extract(p_str, "[0-9.]+"))
      }
      
      return(data.frame(
        Imputation = imputation_num,
        LRT_ChiSquare = lrt_stat,
        DF = df,
        P_Value = p_value
      ))
    }

    ## 循环:10个插补数据集的结果
    {
      # 存储所有结果的列表
      lrt_results_list <- list()
      
      for (i in 1:10) {
        # 构建文件路径
        model0_path <- here("interge_rela", 
                            "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22",
                            paste0("pp_lgca_type1_edu_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r_LRT_0", i, ".out"))
        model1_path <- here("interge_rela", 
                            "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22",
                            paste0("pp_lgca_type1_edu_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r_LRT_1", i, ".out"))
        
        cat("\nProcessing imputation", i, "...\n")
        
        # 读取模型
        model0 <- readModels(model0_path, quiet = TRUE)
        model1 <- readModels(model1_path, quiet = TRUE)
        
        # 提取LRT结果
        lrt_result <- extract_lrt_info(model0, model1, i)
        lrt_results_list[[i]] <- lrt_result
        
        # 显示当前结果
        cat("  LRT χ² =", lrt_result$LRT_ChiSquare, 
            ", ∆df =", lrt_result$DF,
            ", p-value =", lrt_result$P_Value, "\n")
      }
      
      # 3.合并所有结果
      lrt_results_df <- bind_rows(lrt_results_list)
      
      cat("\n" %+% rep("=", 70) %+% "\n")
      cat("所有10个插补数据集的LRT结果\n")
      cat(rep("=", 70) %+% "\n\n")
      print(lrt_results_df)
      
      # 4.计算平均结果
      lrt_summary <- data.frame(
        Statistic = c("Mean LRT χ²", 
                      "SD LRT χ²", 
                      "Min LRT χ²",
                      "Max LRT χ²",
                      "Mean ∆df", 
                      "Mean P-Value", 
                      "SD P-Value",
                      "Min P-Value",
                      "Max P-Value",
                      "显著结果数 (p<0.05)",
                      "显著性一致性"),
        Value = c(
          round(mean(lrt_results_df$LRT_ChiSquare, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          round(sd(lrt_results_df$LRT_ChiSquare, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          round(min(lrt_results_df$LRT_ChiSquare, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          round(max(lrt_results_df$LRT_ChiSquare, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          round(mean(lrt_results_df$DF, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
          round(mean(lrt_results_df$P_Value, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          round(sd(lrt_results_df$P_Value, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          round(min(lrt_results_df$P_Value, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          round(max(lrt_results_df$P_Value, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          sum(lrt_results_df$P_Value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
          ifelse(sum(lrt_results_df$P_Value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) >= 8, "High (>=8/10)", 
                 ifelse(sum(lrt_results_df$P_Value > 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) >= 8, "High (>=8/10)", "Moderate"))
        )
      )
      
      cat("\n" %+% rep("=", 70) %+% "\n")
      cat("汇总统计结果\n")
      cat(rep("=", 70) %+% "\n\n")
      print(lrt_summary)
    }

  ### 直接效应异质性稳健性检验
  # 分组样本稳健性检验有两种方式
  # 1. 似然比卡方检验(MLR Chi-Square Difference Test)
  # 2. wald test
  # 
  # 之所以将分组回归作为稳健性检验, 是 LGCM对样本总量敏感, 分组模型需要以各子模型的同样使用 轨迹形态的假设, 当样本量过少(如edu=1)时, 轨迹形态会发生变化
  # 
  # 尽管 李曦(2025), Carrizales(2025)都使用Mplus执行了平行过程LGCM 分组回归,但是都是非插补数据,
  # 由于, Mplus的MI数据尚无法执行MLR Chi-Square Difference Test, 
  # 故 使用Model constraint手动检验各组模型系数的差异.
  # # Muthen2019年说MI不支持卡方检验. eg. https://www.statmodel.com/discussion/messages/11/934.html?1139418496
  # # 文献1(中文): 李曦, 纪林芹, 迟晓慧, 王舒冉, 张文新, 曹衍淼. (2025). 多巴胺系统基因调节青少年同伴拒绝与亲社会行为关系: 平行潜增长模型. 心理学报, 57(4), 584-598.
  # # 文献2(英文): Carrizales, A., Carlo, G., & Lannegrand, L. (2025). A parallel-process analysis of the longitudinal associations between adolescents’ empathy and prosocial behaviors. Developmental Psychology, 61(9), 1669–1683. https://doi.org/10.1037/dev0001937
  {
    ##### 性别 的 调节效应
    {
      # 均值
      {
        pp_lgca <- mplusObject( 
          TITLE = glue(
            "Class-1_pp_LGCA"),
          
          VARIABLE = glue(
            "
GROUPING = sex12(0 = female 1 = male); 
usevar = 
wfdms12 wfdms16 wfdms18 wfdms20 wfdms22 
!wfdcs12 wfdcs16 wfdcs18 wfdcs20 wfdcs22
!wfdds712 wfdds716 wfdds718 wfdds720 wfdds722
!wfdds812 wfdds816 wfdds818 wfdds820 wfdds822
ces8sd12 ces8sd16 ces8sd18 ces8sd20 ces8sd22

!!! time-invar
sex12 edu12 urban12 
prov122 prov123 
cdn12 cdar12 
cdsc121 cdsc122 
minor12 wave  

!!! time-var
ageg12 pinc12 pinc212 cores12 heal121 heal123  
marr12 eco122 eco123 hwc122 hwc123 hukou12 sat12 adl12 finc12  
!ageg14 pinc14 cores14 heal141 heal143 
!marr14 										         hukou14
!ageg16 pinc16 cores16 heal161 heal163 
!marr16 eco162 eco163 hwc162 hwc163 hukou16 
!ageg18 pinc18 cores18 heal181 heal183 
!marr18 eco182 eco183 hwc182 hwc183 hukou18
!ageg20 pinc20 cores20 heal201 heal203 
!marr20 eco202 eco203 hwc202 hwc203 hukou20 
!ageg22 pinc22 cores22 heal221 heal223 
!marr22 eco222 eco223 hwc222 hwc223 hukou22
;
idvariable=pid;
cluster=fid;"
          ),
          
          ANALYSIS =
            "estimator = mlr;
TYPE=COMPLEX;
!TYPE = RANDOM;
!type = mixture;
!ALGORITHM=INTEGRATION;
!INTEGRATION = MONTECARLO;
!starts = 600 200;
!starts = 20;
!LRTBOOTSTRAP = 200;
!processors = 10;
coverage = 0.005;",
          
          MODEL = 
            "
i1 s1 | wfdms12@0 wfdms16*4 wfdms18*6 wfdms20*8 wfdms22@10;
!i2 s2 | wfdcs12@0 wfdcs16*4 wfdcs18*6 wfdcs20*8 wfdcs22@10;  
!i3 s3 | wfdds712@0 wfdds716@4 wfdds718@6 wfdds720@8 wfdds722@10;  
!i4 s4 | wfdds812@0 wfdds816@4 wfdds818@6 wfdds820@8 wfdds822@10;
i5 s5 | ces8sd12@0 ces8sd16*4 ces8sd18*6 ces8sd20*8 ces8sd22@10; 
!s5@0;

!i1 WITH s1;
!i2 WITH s2;
!i3 WITH s3;
!i4 WITH s4;
!i5 WITH s5;

!!! correlation among residual error terms of three indicators at each time point
!wfdms12 wfdcs12 wfdds712 wfdds812 WITH wfdms12 wfdcs12 wfdds712 wfdds812;
!wfdms16 wfdcs16 wfdds716 wfdds816 WITH wfdms16 wfdcs16 wfdds716 wfdds816;
!wfdms18 wfdcs18 wfdds718 wfdds818 WITH wfdms18 wfdcs18 wfdds718 wfdds818;
!wfdms20 wfdcs20 wfdds720 wfdds820 WITH wfdms20 wfdcs20 wfdds720 wfdds820;
!wfdms22 wfdcs22 wfdds722 wfdds822 WITH wfdms22 wfdcs22 wfdds722 wfdds822;

!!! Focus: intercept of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
!i5 on i1 sex12 i1sx_int;
i5 on i1(b1i);

!!! Focus: slope of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
!s5 on i1 i5 s1 sex12 i1sx_int s1sx_int;
!s5 on i5 s1;
s5 on i5;
s5 on i1 (b1s);
s5 on s1 (b4s);

!i5 s5 on wfdms12;

!!! control: for long trend
! time-invar
i5 s5 on edu12 urban12 prov122 prov123; 
i5 s5 on cdn12 cdar12 cdsc121 cdsc122 minor12 wave ;

! time-var
i5 s5 on ageg12 pinc12 pinc212 cores12 heal121 heal123 ;
i5 s5 on marr12 hukou12 eco122 eco123 hwc122 hwc123 sat12 adl12 finc12;

!!! control: for short trend
! coefficients were constrained to be equal over all waves
!ces8sd12 on ageg12 pinc12 pinc212 cores12 heal121 heal123  (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd12 on marr12 hukou12 eco122 eco123 hwc122 hwc123 (p7-p12); 

!ces8sd14 on ageg14 pinc14 cores14 heal141 heal143 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd14 on marr14 hukou14 (p7-p8);	

!ces8sd16 on ageg16 pinc16 cores16 heal161 heal163 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd16 on marr16 hukou16 eco162 eco163 hwc162 hwc163 (p7-p12); 

!ces8sd18 on ageg18 pinc18 cores18 heal181 heal183 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd18 on marr18 hukou18 eco182 eco183 hwc182 hwc183 (p7-p12); 

!ces8sd20 on ageg20 pinc20 cores20 heal201 heal203 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd20 on marr20 hukou20 eco202 eco203 hwc202 hwc203 (p7-p12);  

!ces8sd22 on ageg22 pinc22 cores22 heal221 heal223 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd22 on marr22 hukou22 eco222 eco223 hwc222 hwc223 (p7-p12);

!!! FIML for missing data
!pinc12 cdar12;



MODEL female:
!!! Focus: intercept of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
i5 on i1(f1);

!!! Focus: slope of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
s5 on i5 ;
s5 on i1(f2); 
s5 on s1(f3);

MODEL male:
!!! Focus: intercept of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
i5 on i1(m1);

!!! Focus: slope of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
s5 on i5 ;
s5 on i1(m2); 
s5 on s1(m3);


MODEL CONSTRAINT:

NEW (diff1 diff2 diff3);

diff1=f1-m1;
diff2=f2-m2;
diff3=f3-m3;
  ",
          
          OUTPUT = 
            "tech1 tech8 tech10 tech11 tech14 sampstat patterns stdyx;",
          
          SAVEDATA = glue(
            "FILE = lgca_type1_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r_mg_result.txt;
!SAVE = CPROB;"),
          
          PLOT =
            "type = plot3;",
          
          usevariables = colnames(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data), 
          rdata = lgca_covar_MI_tics_data,
          imputed = TRUE
        )  
        
        # 构造新文件夹result_gmm路径 
        newdir <- file.path(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
        # 自动创建文件夹, recursive = TRUE, 覆盖原有文件夹
        if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
          dir.create(newdir, recursive = TRUE)
        }
        # 检查目录是否创建成功
        if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
          stop("目录创建失败，请检查路径和权限。")
        }
        # 设定工作目录
        setwd(newdir)   
        # 指定了要执行运算的模型, 即上面定义的包含有Mplus代码的模型    
        pp_lgca_fit <- mplusModeler(pp_lgca, 
                                    dataout = "pp_lgca_type1_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r_mg.dat", 
                                    modelout = glue("c_pp_lgca_type1_sex_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r_mg.inp"), 
                                    check = TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)  
      }  
      # 方差
      {
        pp_lgca <- mplusObject( 
          TITLE = glue(
            "Class-1_pp_LGCA"),
          
          VARIABLE = glue(
            "
GROUPING = sex12(0 = female 1 = male);

# 2. 调节效应模型估计

##### 调节效应 (LMS, 调节变量视为观测变量2-step approach)

  ### 线性调节效应(调节变量=连续变量+标准化, 选用, 不显著)
  {
    ###### 多个调节效应同时估计(放弃, 不显著 且 不收敛)
    {
      ### 标准差 对 均值 的调节效应
      {
        ## step1: process2 = SD
        {
          # shape_factor
          
          pp_lgca <- mplusObject( 
            TITLE = glue(
              "Class-1_pp_LGCA"),
            
            VARIABLE = glue(
              "usevar =

!ces8sd12 ces8sd16 ces8sd18 ces8sd20 ces8sd22
;

idvariable=pid;

auxiliary = 
fid
wfdms12 wfdms16 wfdms18 wfdms20 wfdms22 
!wfdcs12 wfdcs16 wfdcs18 wfdcs20 wfdcs22

      {
        library(dplyr)
        library(MplusAutomation)
        library(here)
        
        #Read all models for enumeration table
        #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
        here()
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值
        output.cesd8.type12_i1i2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type12_r_step2_i_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type12_i1s2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type12_r_step2_s_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差
        output.cesd8.type12_s1i2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type12_r_step2_i_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 排行差
        output.cesd8.type12_s1s2 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type12_r_step2_s_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i1i2
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type12_i1i2 <- output.cesd8.type12_i1i2[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7,
              # predictor.var %in% c("WIII_LO","WIIS_LO","WISS_LO","WSIS_LO","WSSS_LO") ~ 8,
              # predictor.var %in% c("WIII_MOD","WIIS_MOD","WISS_MOD","WSIS_MOD","WSSS_MOD") ~ 9,
              # predictor.var %in% c("WIII_HI","WIIS_HI","WISS_HI","WSIS_HI","WSSS_HI") ~ 10
              predictor.var %in% c("I_MIN","I_LO","I_MOD","I_HI","I_MAX") ~ 8,
              predictor.var %in% c("S_MIN","S_LO","S_MOD","S_HI","S_MAX") ~ 9
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        model.result.type12_i1i2
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type12_i1i2[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
        S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
        
        # 3. 提取模型拟合指数
        summaries <- output.cesd8.type12_i1i2[["summaries"]]
        AIC <- summaries$AIC_Mean[1]
        BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]
        CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
        TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
        RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
        
        # 4. 创建拟合指数文本

                                       ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
        
        # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
        model.result.type12_i1i2 <- model.result.type12_i1i2 %>% 
          add_row(
            predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
            I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),
            S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
          ) %>% 
          add_row(
            predictor.var = "Model fit index",
            I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
            S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
          ) %>% 
          mutate(
            predictor.var.common = case_when(
              # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
              # predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ "SEX",
              # predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
              predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
              predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
              TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
            ))
        
        model.result.type12_i1i2
        
        
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i1s2

!wsis_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i4_min});
!wsis_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
!wsis_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
!wsis_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var)); 
!wsis_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i4_max});

!!! s on s * s
NEW (wsss_min wsss_lo wsss_mod wsss_hi wsss_max);
wsss_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s4_min});
wsss_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
wsss_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
wsss_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var)); 
wsss_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s4_max});

!*
!!! range for x
NEW (x_low x_high);
x_low = x_mean - sqrt(x_var);
x_high = x_mean + sqrt(x_var);

!!! range for w
NEW (w_low w_high);
w_low = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);
w_high = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);
*!
  
!*
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Simple-slope Plot 2 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! (x-axis = xvalue, y = yvalue, legend = different level of moderator)
!!! merit: the trend of y / different pattern of slope.
!
!    X_LOW    3.701      0.023    163.034      0.000
!    X_HIGH   4.464      0.020    219.375      0.000
!    W_LOW   -0.012      0.012     -1.004      0.315
!    W_HIGH   0.372      0.018     20.350      0.000


Loop(xvalue, 3.701, 4.464, 0.1);

Plot(
  
  Pwiii_lo Pwiiimod Pwiii_hi 
  Pwiis_lo Pwiismod Pwiis_hi 
  Pwiss_lo Pwissmod Pwiss_hi 
  Pwsis_lo Pwsismod Pwsis_hi 
  Pwsss_lo Pwsssmod Pwsss_hi 
  
);

!!! Direct effect(s) of Xm on Ym, conditional on Wm: (b1 + b3*W)X !!!
! b1 + b3*W

Pwiii_lo = wiii_lo * xvalue;
Pwiiimod = wiii_mod * xvalue;
Pwiii_hi = wiii_hi * xvalue;

Pwiis_lo = wiis_lo * xvalue;
Pwiismod = wiis_mod * xvalue;
Pwiis_hi = wiis_hi * xvalue;

Pwiss_lo = wiss_lo * xvalue;
Pwissmod = wiss_mod * xvalue;
Pwiss_hi = wiss_hi * xvalue;

Pwsis_lo = wsis_lo * xvalue;
Pwsismod = wsis_mod * xvalue;
Pwsis_hi = wsis_hi * xvalue;

Pwsss_lo = wsss_lo * xvalue;
Pwsssmod = wsss_mod * xvalue;
Pwsss_hi = wsss_hi * xvalue;

*!
  

!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Johnson-Neyman Plot !!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! (x-axis = moderator, y-axis = slope of predictor)
!!! merit: Johnson-neyman interval
!!! note: Johnson-Neyman Plot is only applicable with Dummy coding, not Effect coding

! S4  {wvalue_s4_min}    {wvalue_s4_max}

  !JN_wsis

);

!JN_wsis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I4
JN_wsss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S4

              # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4") ~ "Slope",
              # predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ "SEX",
              # predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I2SX_INT","I3SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
              predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
              predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
              TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
            ))
        
        model.result.type14_s1i4  
        
        
        
        
        
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### s1s4
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type14_s1s4 <- output.cesd8.type14_s1s4[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type14_s1s4[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
        S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]

            predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",

              # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",

              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,

        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type14_i1s4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_4_r_step2_s_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差

        ## 排行差

        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i1i4
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type14_i1i4 <- output.cesd8.type14_i1i4[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"

              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square

          add_row(
            predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
            I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),
            S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
          ) %>%

            predictor.var = "Model fit index",
            I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
            S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1

          mutate(
            predictor.var.common = case_when(
              # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4") ~ "Intercept",

              predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
              predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
              TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
            ))
        
        model.result.type14_s1s4

        library(dplyr)
