        library(here)
        
        #Read all models for enumeration table
        #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
        here()
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值
        output.cesd8.type21_i2i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step2_i_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type21_i2s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step2_s_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差
        output.cesd8.type21_s2i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step2_i_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 排行差
        output.cesd8.type21_s2s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step2_s_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i2i1
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type21_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type21_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I2") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type21_i2i1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]

!type = mixture;
ALGORITHM=INTEGRATION;
!INTEGRATION = MONTECARLO;
!starts = 600 200;
!starts = 20;
!LRTBOOTSTRAP = 200;
!processors = 10;
coverage = 0.005;",
            
            MODEL = 
              "
!i1 s1 | wfdms12@0 wfdms16*4 wfdms18*6 wfdms20*8 wfdms22@10;
!i2 s2 | wfdcs12@0 wfdcs16*4 wfdcs18*6 wfdcs20*8 wfdcs22@10;  
i3 s3 | wfdds712@0 wfdds716@4 wfdds718@6 wfdds720@8 wfdds722@10;  
!i4 s4 | wfdds812@0 wfdds816@4 wfdds818@6 wfdds820@8 wfdds822@10;
i5 s5 | ces8sd12@0 ces8sd16*4 ces8sd18*6 ces8sd20*8 ces8sd22@10;  

!s5@0;
![i3](x_mean);
!i3(x_var);

![s3](x_mean);
!s3(x_var);

![i1](w_mean);
!i1(w_var);

[s1](w_mean);
s1(w_var);

!!! correlation among residual error terms of three indicators at each time point
!wfdms12 wfdcs12 wfdds712 wfdds812 WITH wfdms12 wfdcs12 wfdds712 wfdds812;
!wfdms16 wfdcs16 wfdds716 wfdds816 WITH wfdms16 wfdcs16 wfdds716 wfdds816;
!wfdms18 wfdcs18 wfdds718 wfdds818 WITH wfdms18 wfdcs18 wfdds718 wfdds818;
!wfdms20 wfdcs20 wfdds720 wfdds820 WITH wfdms20 wfdcs20 wfdds720 wfdds820;
!wfdms22 wfdcs22 wfdds722 wfdds822 WITH wfdms22 wfdcs22 wfdds722 wfdds822;

i3s1_int | i3 XWITH s1;

!!! Focus: intercept of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
!i5 on i1 i3;
i5 on i3(b1i);
i5 on i1(b2i);

!!! Focus: slope of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
!s5 on i1 i1 i5 s1 s3 i3s1_int;
s5 on i5 s3 i3; !!! s2 was removed due to non-convergence
s5 on i3 (b1s);
s5 on s1 (b2s);
s5 on i3s1_int (b3s);

!!! control: for long trend
! time-invar
i5 s5 on sex12 edu12 urban12 prov122 prov123;
i5 s5 on cdn12 cdar12 cdsc121 cdsc122 minor12 wave ;

! time-var
i5 s5 on ageg12 pinc12 pinc212 cores12 heal121 heal123;
i5 s5 on marr12 hukou12 eco122 eco123 hwc122 hwc123 sat12 adl12 finc12;

!!! control: for short trend
! coefficients were constrained to be equal over all waves
!ces8sd12 on ageg12 pincm112 pincm212 cores12 heal121 heal123 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd12 on marr12 hukou12 eco122 eco123 hwc122 hwc123 (p7-p12); 

!ces8sd14 on ageg14 pinc14 cores14 heal141 heal143 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd14 on marr14 hukou14 (p7-p8);	

!ces8sd16 on ageg16 pinc16 cores16 heal161 heal163 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd16 on marr16 hukou16 eco162 eco163 hwc162 hwc163 (p7-p12); 

!ces8sd18 on ageg18 pinc18 cores18 heal181 heal183 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd18 on marr18 hukou18 eco182 eco183 hwc182 hwc183 (p7-p12); 

!ces8sd20 on ageg20 pinc20 cores20 heal201 heal203 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd20 on marr20 hukou20 eco202 eco203 hwc202 hwc203 (p7-p12);  

!ces8sd22 on ageg22 pinc22 cores22 heal221 heal223 (p1-p5); 
!ces8sd22 on marr22 hukou22 eco222 eco223 hwc222 hwc223 (p7-p12);

!!! FIML for missing data
!pincm112 pincm212 cdar12;
    ",
            
            
            MODELCONSTRAINT = 
              glue(
                "
!!! i on i * i
!NEW (wiii_min wiii_lo wiii_mod wiii_hi wiii_max);
!wiii_min = b1i + b3i*({wvalue_i1_min});
!wiii_lo = b1i + b3i*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
!wiii_mod = b1i + b3i*w_mean;
!wiii_hi = b1i + b3i*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var));
!wiii_max = b1i + b3i*({wvalue_i1_max});

!!! s on i * i
!NEW (wiis_min wiis_lo wiis_mod wiis_hi wiis_max);
!wiis_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_min});
!wiis_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
!wiis_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
!wiis_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var));
!wiis_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_max});

!!! s on i * s
NEW (wiss_min wiss_lo wiss_mod wiss_hi wiss_max);
wiss_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_min});
wiss_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
wiss_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
wiss_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var));
wiss_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_max});

!!! s on s * i
!NEW (wsis_min wsis_lo wsis_mod wsis_hi wsis_max);
!wsis_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_min});
!wsis_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
!wsis_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
!wsis_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var)); 
!wsis_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_max});

!!! s on s * s
!NEW (wsss_min wsss_lo wsss_mod wsss_hi wsss_max);
!wsss_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_min});
!wsss_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
!wsss_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
!wsss_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var)); 
!wsss_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_max});

!*
!!! range for x
NEW (x_low x_high);
x_low = x_mean - sqrt(x_var);
x_high = x_mean + sqrt(x_var);

!!! range for w
NEW (w_low w_high);
w_low = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);
w_high = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);
*!
  
!*
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Simple-slope Plot 2 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! (x-axis = xvalue, y = yvalue, legend = different level of moderator)
!!! merit: the trend of y / different pattern of slope.
!
!    X_LOW    3.701      0.023    163.034      0.000
!    X_HIGH   4.464      0.020    219.375      0.000
!    W_LOW   -0.012      0.012     -1.004      0.315
!    W_HIGH   0.372      0.018     20.350      0.000


Loop(xvalue, 3.701, 4.464, 0.1);

Plot(
  
  Pwiii_lo Pwiiimod Pwiii_hi 
  Pwiis_lo Pwiismod Pwiis_hi 
  Pwiss_lo Pwissmod Pwiss_hi 
  Pwsis_lo Pwsismod Pwsis_hi 
  Pwsss_lo Pwsssmod Pwsss_hi 
  
);

!!! Direct effect(s) of Xm on Ym, conditional on Wm: (b1 + b3*W)X !!!
! b1 + b3*W

Pwiii_lo = wiii_lo * xvalue;
Pwiiimod = wiii_mod * xvalue;
Pwiii_hi = wiii_hi * xvalue;

Pwiis_lo = wiis_lo * xvalue;
Pwiismod = wiis_mod * xvalue;
Pwiis_hi = wiis_hi * xvalue;

Pwiss_lo = wiss_lo * xvalue;
Pwissmod = wiss_mod * xvalue;
Pwiss_hi = wiss_hi * xvalue;

Pwsis_lo = wsis_lo * xvalue;
Pwsismod = wsis_mod * xvalue;
Pwsis_hi = wsis_hi * xvalue;

Pwsss_lo = wsss_lo * xvalue;
Pwsssmod = wsss_mod * xvalue;
Pwsss_hi = wsss_hi * xvalue;

*!
  

!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Johnson-Neyman Plot !!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! (x-axis = moderator, y-axis = slope of predictor)
!!! merit: Johnson-neyman interval
!!! note: Johnson-Neyman Plot is only applicable with Dummy coding, not Effect coding
!
!     min                max 
! I1  {wvalue_i1_min}    {wvalue_i1_max} 
! S2  {wvalue_s1_min}    {wvalue_s1_max}
!

!!! wvalue is range of I1
!Loop (wvalue, {wvalue_i1_min}, {wvalue_i1_max}, 0.05);
!!! wvalue is range of S2
Loop (wvalue, {wvalue_s1_min}, {wvalue_s1_max}, 0.05);

Plot (
  
  !JN_wiii
  !JN_wiis
  JN_wiss
  !JN_wsis
  !JN_wsss
  
);

!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! Direct effect(s) of X on Y, conditional on W: (b1 + b3*W)X !!!

!JN_wiii = b1i + b3i*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I1
!JN_wiis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I1
JN_wiss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S2
!JN_wsis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I1
!JN_wsss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S2


  "),
            
            OUTPUT = 
              "tech1 tech4 tech10 tech11 tech14 sampstat patterns stdyx;",
            
            SAVEDATA = glue(
              "FILE = pp_lgca_type31_r_step2_s_mod_i_MI_TICs_result.txt;
!SAVE = CPROB;"),
            
            PLOT =
              "type = plot3;",
            
            usevariables = colnames(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data), 
            rdata = lgca_covar_MI_tics_data,
            imputed = TRUE
          ) 
          
          # 构造新文件夹result_gmm路径 
          newdir <- file.path(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
          # 自动创建文件夹, recursive = TRUE, 覆盖原有文件夹
          if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
            dir.create(newdir, recursive = TRUE)
          }
          # 检查目录是否创建成功
          if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
            stop("目录创建失败，请检查路径和权限。")
          }
          # 设定工作目录
          setwd(newdir)   
          # 指定了要执行运算的模型, 即上面定义的包含有Mplus代码的模型    
          pp_lgca_fit <- mplusModeler(pp_lgca, 
                                      dataout = "pp_lgca_type31_r_step2_s_mod_i_MI_TICs.dat", 
                                      modelout = glue("pp_lgca_type31_r_step2_s_mod_i_MI_TICs.inp"),
                                      check = TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)  
        }

          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",

              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",

              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",

              TRUE ~ ""

!wiis_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
!wiis_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var));
!wiis_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_max});

!!! s on i * s
!NEW (wiss_min wiss_lo wiss_mod wiss_hi wiss_max);
!wiss_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_min});
!wiss_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
!wiss_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
!wiss_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var));
!wiss_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_max});

!!! s on s * i
!NEW (wsis_min wsis_lo wsis_mod wsis_hi wsis_max);
!wsis_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_min});
!wsis_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
!wsis_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
!wsis_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var)); 
!wsis_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_max});

!!! s on s * s
NEW (wsss_min wsss_lo wsss_mod wsss_hi wsss_max);
wsss_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_min});
wsss_lo = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
wsss_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
wsss_hi = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var)); 
wsss_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_max}); 

!*
!!! range for x
NEW (x_low x_high);
x_low = x_mean - sqrt(x_var);
x_high = x_mean + sqrt(x_var);

!!! range for w
NEW (w_low w_high);
w_low = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);
w_high = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);
*!
  
!*
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Simple-slope Plot 2 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! (x-axis = xvalue, y = yvalue, legend = different level of moderator)
!!! merit: the trend of y / different pattern of slope.
!
!    X_LOW    3.701      0.023    163.034      0.000
!    X_HIGH   4.464      0.020    219.375      0.000
!    W_LOW   -0.012      0.012     -1.004      0.315
!    W_HIGH   0.372      0.018     20.350      0.000


Loop(xvalue, 3.701, 4.464, 0.1);

Plot(
  
  Pwiii_lo Pwiiimod Pwiii_hi 
  Pwiis_lo Pwiismod Pwiis_hi 
  Pwiss_lo Pwissmod Pwiss_hi 
  Pwsis_lo Pwsismod Pwsis_hi 
  Pwsss_lo Pwsssmod Pwsss_hi 
  
);

!!! Direct effect(s) of Xm on Ym, conditional on Wm: (b1 + b3*W)X !!!
! b1 + b3*W

Pwiii_lo = wiii_lo * xvalue;
Pwiiimod = wiii_mod * xvalue;
Pwiii_hi = wiii_hi * xvalue;

Pwiis_lo = wiis_lo * xvalue;
Pwiismod = wiis_mod * xvalue;
Pwiis_hi = wiis_hi * xvalue;

Pwiss_lo = wiss_lo * xvalue;
Pwissmod = wiss_mod * xvalue;
Pwiss_hi = wiss_hi * xvalue;

Pwsis_lo = wsis_lo * xvalue;
Pwsismod = wsis_mod * xvalue;
Pwsis_hi = wsis_hi * xvalue;

Pwsss_lo = wsss_lo * xvalue;
Pwsssmod = wsss_mod * xvalue;
Pwsss_hi = wsss_hi * xvalue;

*!
  

!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Johnson-Neyman Plot !!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! (x-axis = moderator, y-axis = slope of predictor)
!!! merit: Johnson-neyman interval
!!! note: Johnson-Neyman Plot is only applicable with Dummy coding, not Effect coding
!
!     min                max 
! I1  {wvalue_i1_min}    {wvalue_i1_max} 
! S2  {wvalue_s1_min}    {wvalue_s1_max}

!Loop (wvalue, {wvalue_i1_min}, {wvalue_i1_max}, 0.05);
!!! wvalue is range of S2
Loop (wvalue, {wvalue_s1_min}, {wvalue_s1_max}, 0.05);

Plot (

  !JN_wsis

);

!!! X as focal antecedent variable

!JN_wiss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S2
!JN_wsis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I1
JN_wsss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S2

        model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                       ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
        
        # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
        model.result.type41_s4i1 <- model.result.type41_s4i1 %>% 
          add_row(
            predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
            I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),
            S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
          ) %>% 
          add_row(
            predictor.var = "Model fit index",
            I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
            S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
          ) %>% 
          mutate(
            predictor.var.common = case_when(
              # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I4", "I4", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4", "S4") ~ "Slope",

              # predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I4SX_INT","I4SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S4SX_INT","S4SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
              predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
              predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
              TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
            ))

        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### s4s1
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type41_s4s1 <- output.cesd8.type41_s4s1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I4", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4S1_INT","S1S4_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type41_s4s1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]

          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",

              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),

              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",

              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")

              predictor.var %in% c("S4S1_INT","S1S4_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>%

        CFI <- summaries$CFI_Mean[1]
        TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
        RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]
        
        # 4. 创建拟合指数文本
        model.fit_text.type1 <- paste0("AIC=", sprintf("%.2f", AIC), 
                                       ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))
        
        # 5. 添加 Pseudo-R² 行和 Model fit index 行
        model.result.type41_s4s1 <- model.result.type41_s4s1 %>% 
          add_row(
            predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",
            I5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", I5_r2),
            S5.ON = sprintf("%.3f", S5_r2)
          ) %>% 
          add_row(
            predictor.var = "Model fit index",
            I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,
            S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1
          ) %>% 
          mutate(

              # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I4", "I4", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4", "S4") ~ "Slope",

              # predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I4SX_INT","I4SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Intercept",

              predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
              TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
            ))
        
        model.result.type41_s4s1  
        
        
        
        
        
        model.result.type41_i4i1

        library(dplyr)

        model.result.type41_all <- model.result.type41_i4i1 %>%
          select(predictor.var.common, I5.ON, S5.ON) %>%

              rename(I5.ON.SS = I5.ON, S5.ON.SS = S5.ON),
            by = "predictor.var.common"
          ) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S4") ~ 1,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1", "I4", "I4") ~ 2,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4") ~ 3,         
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7,
              # predictor.var.common %in% c("I_MIN","I_LO","I_MOD","I_HI","I_MAX") ~ 8,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("MIN","LO","MOD","HI","MAX") ~ 9
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)

      # 1.定义辅助函数：从compareModels输出中提取LRT统计量
      extract_lrt_info <- function(model0, model1, imputation_num) {
        # 捕获compareModels()的控制台输出
        output <- capture.output(
          compareModels(model0, model1,
                        show = c("summaries"),
                        equalityMargin = c(param = .05, pvalue = .02),
                        sort = "type", diffTest = TRUE, showNS = FALSE)
        )
        
        # 解析LRT统计量、自由度和p值
        lrt_stat <- NA
        df <- NA
        p_value <- NA
        
        # 查找包含 "Chi-square difference:" 的行
        chi_line <- grep("Chi-square difference:", output, value = TRUE)
        if (length(chi_line) > 0) {
          # 提取冒号后的所有内容，然后提取数字（包括负号）
          chi_str <- str_trim(str_extract(chi_line[1], ":\\s*(-?[0-9.]+)"))
          lrt_stat <- as.numeric(str_extract(chi_str, "-?[0-9.]+"))
        }
        
        # 查找包含 "Diff degrees of freedom:" 的行
        df_line <- grep("Diff degrees of freedom:", output, value = TRUE)
        if (length(df_line) > 0) {
          df_str <- str_trim(str_extract(df_line[1], ":\\s*([0-9]+)"))
          df <- as.numeric(str_extract(df_str, "[0-9]+"))
        }
        
        # 查找包含 "P-value:" 的行
        p_line <- grep("P-value:", output, value = TRUE)
        if (length(p_line) > 0) {
          p_str <- str_trim(str_extract(p_line[1], ":\\s*([0-9.]+)"))
          p_value <- as.numeric(str_extract(p_str, "[0-9.]+"))
        }
        
        return(data.frame(
          Imputation = imputation_num,
          LRT_ChiSquare = lrt_stat,
          DF = df,
          P_Value = p_value
        ))
      }
      
      # 2.主循环：读取模型并提取LRT结果
      
      
      ## 举例:一个插补数据集的结果
      # ∆df = 5, P-value = 1

                    sort = "type", diffTest = TRUE, showNS = FALSE)

          # 构建文件路径
          model0_path <- here("interge_rela", 
                              "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22",
                              paste0("pp_lgca_type14_r_step2_s_mod_i_MI_TICs_LRT_0", i, ".out"))
          model1_path <- here("interge_rela", 
                              "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22",
                              paste0("pp_lgca_type14_r_step2_s_mod_i_MI_TICs_LRT_1", i, ".out"))
          
          cat("\nProcessing imputation", i, "...\n")
          
          # 读取模型
          model0 <- readModels(model0_path, quiet = TRUE)
          model1 <- readModels(model1_path, quiet = TRUE)
          
          # 提取LRT结果
          lrt_result <- extract_lrt_info(model0, model1, i)
          lrt_results_list[[i]] <- lrt_result
          
          # 显示当前结果
          cat("  LRT χ² =", lrt_result$LRT_ChiSquare, 
              ", ∆df =", lrt_result$DF,
              ", p-value =", lrt_result$P_Value, "\n")
        }
        
        # 3.合并所有结果
        lrt_results_df <- bind_rows(lrt_results_list)
        
        cat("\n" %+% rep("=", 70) %+% "\n")
        cat("所有10个插补数据集的LRT结果\n")
        cat(rep("=", 70) %+% "\n\n")
        print(lrt_results_df)
        
        # 4.计算平均结果
        lrt_summary <- data.frame(
          Statistic = c("Mean LRT χ²", 
                        "SD LRT χ²", 
                        "Min LRT χ²",
                        "Max LRT χ²",
                        "Mean ∆df", 
                        "Mean P-Value", 
                        "SD P-Value",
                        "Min P-Value",
                        "Max P-Value",
                        "显著结果数 (p<0.05)",
                        "显著性一致性"),
          Value = c(
            round(mean(lrt_results_df$LRT_ChiSquare, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            round(sd(lrt_results_df$LRT_ChiSquare, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            round(min(lrt_results_df$LRT_ChiSquare, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            round(max(lrt_results_df$LRT_ChiSquare, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            round(mean(lrt_results_df$DF, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
            round(mean(lrt_results_df$P_Value, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            round(sd(lrt_results_df$P_Value, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            round(min(lrt_results_df$P_Value, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            round(max(lrt_results_df$P_Value, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            sum(lrt_results_df$P_Value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            ifelse(sum(lrt_results_df$P_Value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) >= 8, "High (>=8/10)", 
                   ifelse(sum(lrt_results_df$P_Value > 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) >= 8, "High (>=8/10)", "Moderate"))
          )
        )
        
        cat("\n" %+% rep("=", 70) %+% "\n")
        cat("汇总统计结果\n")
        cat(rep("=", 70) %+% "\n\n")
        print(lrt_summary)
      }
      
    }

        #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
        here()
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值

        ### i1i2
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type12_i1i2 <- output.cesd8.type12_i1i2[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>%

          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7,
              # predictor.var %in% c("WIII_LO","WIIS_LO","WISS_LO","WSIS_LO","WSSS_LO") ~ 8,
              # predictor.var %in% c("WIII_MOD","WIIS_MOD","WISS_MOD","WSIS_MOD","WSSS_MOD") ~ 9,
              # predictor.var %in% c("WIII_HI","WIIS_HI","WISS_HI","WSIS_HI","WSSS_HI") ~ 10
              predictor.var %in% c("I_MIN","I_LO","I_MOD","I_HI","I_MAX") ~ 8,
              predictor.var %in% c("S_MIN","S_LO","S_MOD","S_HI","S_MAX") ~ 9
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)

      #### 二维交互简单斜率图
      # 其中，交互项前四个字符依次由X、W构成，例如 I1I3_INT表示 I1为X I3为W；I5.ON 列中的I1I3_INT表示 I1对I5的影响如何受到I3的调节；S5.ON 列中的I1I3_INT表示 I1对S5的影响如何受到I3的调节.
      # 所有的X变量都是连续变量，W都是0/1虚拟变量, Y都是连续变量。
      # 
      # 要求，
      # 若后缀"_INT"的交互项到0.1水平显著性时, 根据MIN（W=0时的边际效应）、MAX（W=1时的边际效应）绘制调节效应的简单斜率图，导出为png格式的代码；
      {
        library(tidyverse)
        library(stringr)
        library(here)
        
        # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格 (同时提取数值和原始字符串)
        parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
          if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
          if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
          
          is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
          
          # 提取数值部分
          coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
          value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
          value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
          
          if (is.na(value)) return(list(value = 0, is_sig = FALSE, raw = coef_part))
          return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig, raw = coef_part))
        }
        
        # 辅助函数：生成标签文本 (如 b = -0.304***)
        get_label_text <- function(raw_str) {
          if (is.na(raw_str)) return("")
          return(paste0("b = ", raw_str))
        }
        
        # 2. 辅助函数：获取自定义轴标签名称
        get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
          if (type == "x") {
            # 横轴映射表
            labels <- c(
              "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
              "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
              "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
              "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
              "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
              "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
              "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
              "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
            )
            if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
            return(code) 
          } else {
            # 纵轴映射表
            labels <- c(
              "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
              "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
            )
            if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
            return(code)
          }
        }
        
        # 3. 辅助函数：获取自定义图例标签
        get_legend_labels <- function(w_label) {
          w_names <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          base_name <- if (w_label %in% names(w_names)) w_names[[w_label]] else w_label
          return(c(paste0(base_name, "<Med"), paste0(base_name, ">Med")))
        }
        
        # 4. 辅助函数：绘制二维交互简单斜率图 (整合防重叠标签逻辑)
        generate_2way_plot <- function(slope_min_val, slope_min_raw,
                                       slope_max_val, slope_max_raw,
                                       w_main_effect,
                                       x_code, w_code, y_code, filename) {
          
          # 获取自定义标签
          x_lab_text <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
          y_lab_text <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
          legend_labs <- get_legend_labels(w_code)
          label_low  <- legend_labs[1]
          label_high <- legend_labs[2]
          
          # 定义 X 轴范围
          x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
          
          # --- 计算 Y 值 ---
          # W=0 (Min)
          b0_min <- 0
          y_min <- c(b0_min + slope_min_val * -1, b0_min + slope_min_val * 1)
          
          # W=1 (Max)
          b0_max <- w_main_effect
          y_max <- c(b0_max + slope_max_val * -1, b0_max + slope_max_val * 1)
          
          # --- 构建绘图数据框 ---
          plot_data <- data.frame(
            x = rep(x_vals, 2),
            y = c(y_min, y_max),
            Condition = rep(c(label_low, label_high), each = 2)
          )
          plot_data$Condition <- factor(plot_data$Condition, levels = c(label_low, label_high))
          
          # --- 构建标签数据 (策略性错开位置) ---
          # Low Group (W=0) 标签放在左侧 x = -0.5
          x_pos_low <- -0.5
          y_pos_low <- b0_min + slope_min_val * x_pos_low
          
          # High Group (W=1) 标签放在右侧 x = 0.5
          x_pos_high <- 0.5
          y_pos_high <- b0_max + slope_max_val * x_pos_high
          
          label_data <- data.frame(
            x = c(x_pos_low, x_pos_high),
            y = c(y_pos_low, y_pos_high),
            Condition = factor(c(label_low, label_high), levels = c(label_low, label_high)),
            Label = c(get_label_text(slope_min_raw), get_label_text(slope_max_raw))
          )
          
          # ── 颜色和线型映射 ────────────────────────────────
          color_values <- setNames(c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"), c(label_low, label_high))
          linetype_values <- setNames(c("solid", "longdash"), c(label_low, label_high))
          
          # --- 绘图 ---
          p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Condition, linetype = Condition)) +
            geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
            geom_point(size = 3) +
            
            # 添加文本标签 (带白色背景，防重叠)
            geom_label(
              data = label_data,
              aes(label = Label),
              size = 3.5,
              label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
              label.size = 0,          # 无边框
              fill = "white",          # 白色背景
              alpha = 0.9,             # 不透明度
              show.legend = FALSE
            ) +
            
            scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
            scale_linetype_manual(values = linetype_values) +
            
            labs(
              x = x_lab_text,
              y = y_lab_text
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(
              legend.title = element_blank(),
              legend.position = "inside",
              legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
              legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
              legend.box.just = "right",
              legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              panel.grid = element_blank()
            )
          
          # 确保目录存在
          dir_name <- dirname(filename)
          if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
          
          ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
          message(paste("    -> Saved plot:", filename))
        }
        
        # 5. 主循环
        data_list <- list(
          type12_i1i2 = model.result.type12_i1i2,
          type12_i1s2 = model.result.type12_i1s2,
          type12_s1i2 = model.result.type12_s1i2,
          type12_s1s2 = model.result.type12_s1s2
        )
        
        for (name in names(data_list)) {
          df <- data_list[[name]]
          message(paste("Processing Dataset:", name))
          
          # 内部辅助函数
          get_val <- function(var_name, col_name) {
            row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == var_name)
            if (nrow(row) == 0) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
            cell_str <- row[[col_name]]
            return(parse_cell(cell_str))
          }
          
          # 查找交互项行 (以 _INT 结尾)
          int_rows <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "_INT$"))
          
          filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                            "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
          
          if (nrow(int_rows) > 0) {
            for(i in 1:nrow(int_rows)) {
              int_row_data <- int_rows[i, ]
              int_var_name <- int_row_data$predictor.var 
              
              # 解析变量名
              x_name <- str_sub(int_var_name, 1, 2) 
              w_name <- str_sub(int_var_name, 3, 4) 
              
              # 尝试获取 W 的主效应行
              w_main_row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == w_name)
              
              # 遍历两列：I5.ON 和 S5.ON
              cols_to_check <- c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")
              
              for (col in cols_to_check) {
                col_label <- ifelse(col == "I5.ON", "I5", "S5")
                
                # 1. 检查交互项显著性
                res_int <- parse_cell(int_row_data[[col]])
                
                if (res_int$is_sig) {
                  message(paste0("  [", col, "] Significant Interaction: ", int_var_name))
                  
                  # 2. 提取简单斜率 (MIN 和 MAX)
                  # 注意：这里需要同时获取 value 和 raw
                  slope_min_obj <- get_val("MIN", col)
                  slope_max_obj <- get_val("MAX", col)
                  
                  # 3. 提取 W 主效应
                  w_main_val <- 0
                  if (nrow(w_main_row) > 0) {
                    val <- parse_cell(w_main_row[[col]])$value
                    if (!is.na(val)) w_main_val <- val
                  }
                  
                  # 检查数据完整性
                  if (is.na(slope_min_obj$value) || is.na(slope_max_obj$value)) {
                    message("    -> Warning: Missing MIN or MAX slope values. Skipping.")
                    next
                  }
                  
                  # 4. 绘图
                  generate_2way_plot(
                    slope_min_val = slope_min_obj$value, slope_min_raw = slope_min_obj$raw,
                    slope_max_val = slope_max_obj$value, slope_max_raw = slope_max_obj$raw,
                    w_main_effect = w_main_val,
                    x_code = x_name,       
                    w_code = w_name,       
                    y_code = col_label,    
                    filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/TwoWay_", name, "_", int_var_name, "_", col_label, ".svg")
                  )
                } 
              }
            }
          } else {
            message("  -> No interaction term (_INT) found.")
          }
        }
      }

          # 构造新文件夹result_gmm路径 
          newdir <- file.path(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))

        lgca_covar_MI_tics <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_covar_mi_tics_catg_conti.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        lgca_covar_MI_tics_data <- lgca_covar_MI_tics[["savedata"]]
        names(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data[["missimp_TICs_catg_conti1.dat"]])
        
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        # 读取所有最优模型结果
        ## process1
        pp_lgca_type13_step1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type13_r_step1.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        pp_lgca_type13_step1.data <- pp_lgca_type13_step1[["savedata"]] %>% 
          # 对 I S 进行类别化

            # ),
            # S3_std = case_when(

          )
        names(pp_lgca_type13_step1.data)

s5@0;

!s1(x_var);

!i3(w_var);

!wfdms22 wfdcs22 wfdds722 wfdds822 WITH wfdms22 wfdcs22 wfdds722 wfdds822;

!wfdms12 WITH ces8sd12;
!wfdms16 WITH ces8sd16;
!wfdms18 WITH ces8sd18;
!wfdms20 WITH ces8sd20;
!wfdms22 WITH ces8sd22;

i1i3_int | i1 XWITH i3;

!!! Focus: intercept of ces8sd regressed on intercept of wfd
!i5 on i1 i3;
i5 on i1(b1i);
i5 on i3(b2i);
i5 on i1i3_int(b3i);

s5 on i1 (b1s);
s5 on i3 (b2s);
s5 on i1i3_int (b3s);

! time-var

!!! control: for short trend

!ces8sd14 on ageg14 pinc14 cores14 heal141 heal143 (p1-p5);

!!! FIML for missing data
!pincm112 pincm212 cdar12;

!!! i on i * i
NEW (wiii_min wiii_max);
wiii_min = b1i + b3i*({wvalue_i3_min});



wiii_max = b1i + b3i*({wvalue_i3_max});

!!! s on i * i
NEW (wiis_min wiis_max);
wiis_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i3_min});



wiis_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i3_max});

!
!
!

x_high = x_mean + sqrt(x_var);

!!! range for w
NEW (w_low w_high);
w_low = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);
w_high = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);

!*
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! (x-axis = xvalue, y = yvalue, legend = different level of moderator)

  Pwiis_lo Pwiismod Pwiis_hi 
  Pwiss_lo Pwissmod Pwiss_hi

!!! Direct effect(s) of Xm on Ym, conditional on Wm: (b1 + b3*W)X !!!
! b1 + b3*W

Pwiii_hi = wiii_hi * xvalue;

Pwiis_lo = wiis_lo * xvalue;
Pwiismod = wiis_mod * xvalue;

Pwsss_hi = wsss_hi * xvalue;

!!! (x-axis = moderator, y-axis = slope of predictor)

              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7,
              # predictor.var.common %in% c("I_MIN","I_LO","I_MOD","I_HI","I_MAX") ~ 8,

      #### 二维交互简单斜率图
      {
        library(tidyverse)
        library(stringr)
        library(here) # 确保加载 here 包
        
        # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格
        parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
          if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
          if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
          
          is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
          coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
          value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
          value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
          
          if (is.na(value)) return(list(value = 0, is_sig = FALSE))
          return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig))
        }
        
        # 2. 辅助函数：获取自定义轴标签名称
        get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
          if (type == "x") {
            # 横轴映射表
            labels <- c(
              "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
              "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
              "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
              "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
              "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
              "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
              "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
              "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
            )
            if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
            return(code) # 默认返回原代码
          } else {
            # 纵轴映射表
            labels <- c(
              "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
              "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
            )
            if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
            return(code)
          }
        }
        
        # 3. 辅助函数：获取自定义图例标签
        # 根据 w_label 动态生成图例
        get_legend_labels <- function(w_label) {
          # 定义全名映射
          w_names <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          
          base_name <- if (w_label %in% names(w_names)) w_names[[w_label]] else w_label
          
          # 返回两个标签：Low (<Med) 和 High (>Med)
          return(c(
            paste0(base_name, "<Med"), 
            paste0(base_name, ">Med")
          ))
        }
        
        # 4. 辅助函数：绘制二维交互简单斜率图
        generate_2way_plot <- function(slope_min, slope_max, w_main_effect,
                                       x_code, w_code, y_code, filename) {
          
          # 获取自定义轴标签
          x_lab_text <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
          y_lab_text <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
          
          # 获取自定义图例标签
          legend_labs <- get_legend_labels(w_code)
          label_low  <- legend_labs[1]
          label_high <- legend_labs[2]
          
          # 定义 X 轴范围 (-1SD 到 +1SD)
          x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
          
          # --- 计算 Y 值 ---
          # W=0 (Min)
          b0_min <- 0
          y_min <- c(b0_min + slope_min * -1, b0_min + slope_min * 1)
          
          # W=1 (Max)
          b0_max <- w_main_effect
          y_max <- c(b0_max + slope_max * -1, b0_max + slope_max * 1)
          
          # --- 构建绘图数据框 ---
          # 注意：这里 Condition 直接使用最终的图例标签
          plot_data <- data.frame(
            x = rep(x_vals, 2),
            y = c(y_min, y_max),
            Condition = rep(c(label_low, label_high), each = 2)
          )
          
          # 设定因子水平以保证图例顺序 (Low 在前, High 在后)
          plot_data$Condition <- factor(plot_data$Condition, levels = c(label_low, label_high))
          
          # ── 颜色和线型 ────────────────────────────────
          # 动态命名向量，键必须与 Condition 的值一致
          color_values <- setNames(c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"), c(label_low, label_high))
          linetype_values <- setNames(c("solid", "longdash"), c(label_low, label_high))
          
          # --- 绘图 ---
          p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Condition, linetype = Condition)) +
            geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
            geom_point(size = 3) +
            
            scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
            scale_linetype_manual(values = linetype_values) +
            
            labs(
              x = x_lab_text,
              y = y_lab_text
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(
              legend.title = element_blank(),
              legend.position = "inside",
              legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
              legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
              legend.box.just = "right",
              legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              panel.grid = element_blank()
            )
          
          # 确保目录存在
          dir_name <- dirname(filename)
          if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) {
            dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
          }
          
          ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
          message(paste("    -> Saved plot:", filename))
        }
        
        # 5. 主循环
        data_list <- list(
          type13_i1i3 = model.result.type13_i1i3,
          type13_i1s3 = model.result.type13_i1s3,
          type13_s1i3 = model.result.type13_s1i3,
          type13_s1s3 = model.result.type13_s1s3
        )
        
        for (name in names(data_list)) {
          df <- data_list[[name]]
          message(paste("Processing Dataset:", name))
          
          # 内部辅助函数
          get_val <- function(var_name, col_name) {
            row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == var_name)
            if (nrow(row) == 0) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE))
            cell_str <- row[[col_name]]
            return(parse_cell(cell_str))
          }
          
          # 查找交互项行 (以 _INT 结尾)
          int_rows <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "_INT$"))
          
          # 定义保存路径前缀
          filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                            "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
          
          if (nrow(int_rows) > 0) {
            for(i in 1:nrow(int_rows)) {
              int_row_data <- int_rows[i, ]
              int_var_name <- int_row_data$predictor.var # 例如 I1I3_INT
              
              # 解析变量名
              x_name <- str_sub(int_var_name, 1, 2) # I1
              w_name <- str_sub(int_var_name, 3, 4) # I3
              
              # 尝试获取 W 的主效应行
              w_main_row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == w_name)
              
              # 遍历两列：I5.ON 和 S5.ON
              cols_to_check <- c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")
              
              for (col in cols_to_check) {
                col_label <- ifelse(col == "I5.ON", "I5", "S5")
                
                # 1. 检查交互项显著性
                res_int <- parse_cell(int_row_data[[col]])
                
                if (res_int$is_sig) {
                  message(paste0("  [", col, "] Significant Interaction: ", int_var_name))
                  
                  # 2. 提取简单斜率 (MIN 和 MAX)
                  slope_min <- get_val("MIN", col)$value
                  slope_max <- get_val("MAX", col)$value
                  
                  # 3. 提取 W 主效应
                  w_main_val <- 0
                  if (nrow(w_main_row) > 0) {
                    val <- parse_cell(w_main_row[[col]])$value
                    if (!is.na(val)) w_main_val <- val
                  }
                  
                  # 检查数据完整性
                  if (is.na(slope_min) || is.na(slope_max)) {
                    message("    -> Warning: Missing MIN or MAX slope values. Skipping.")
                    next
                  }
                  
                  # 4. 绘图
                  generate_2way_plot(
                    slope_min = slope_min,
                    slope_max = slope_max,
                    w_main_effect = w_main_val,
                    x_code = x_name,       # 传入代码 I1
                    w_code = w_name,       # 传入代码 I3
                    y_code = col_label,    # 传入代码 I5 或 S5
                    filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/TwoWay_", name, "_", int_var_name, "_", col_label, ".svg")
                  )
                } 
              }
            }
          } else {
            message("  -> No interaction term (_INT) found.")
          }
        }
      }

        ## process1
        pp_lgca_type14_step1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_r_step1.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        pp_lgca_type14_step1.data <- pp_lgca_type14_step1[["savedata"]] %>%

      {
        library(dplyr)
        library(MplusAutomation)
        library(here)
        
        #Read all models for enumeration table
        #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
        here()
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值
        output.cesd8.type14_i1i4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_r_step2_cat_i_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type14_i1s4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差
        output.cesd8.type14_s1i4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_r_step2_cat_i_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 排行差
        output.cesd8.type14_s1s4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i1i4
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type14_i1i4 <- output.cesd8.type14_i1i4[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

          ) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 2,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 3,         
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7,
              # predictor.var.common %in% c("I_MIN","I_LO","I_MOD","I_HI","I_MAX") ~ 8,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("MIN","LO","MOD","HI","MAX") ~ 9
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)

      #### 二维交互简单斜率图
      {
        library(tidyverse)
        library(stringr)
        library(here)
        
        # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格 (同时提取数值和原始字符串)
        parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
          if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
          if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
          
          is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
          
          # 提取数值部分
          coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
          value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
          value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
          
          if (is.na(value)) return(list(value = 0, is_sig = FALSE, raw = coef_part))
          return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig, raw = coef_part))
        }
        
        # 辅助函数：生成标签文本 (如 b = -0.304***)
        get_label_text <- function(raw_str) {
          if (is.na(raw_str)) return("")
          return(paste0("b = ", raw_str))
        }
        
        # 2. 辅助函数：获取自定义轴标签名称
        get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
          if (type == "x") {
            # 横轴映射表
            labels <- c(
              "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
              "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
              "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
              "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
              "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
              "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
              "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
              "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
            )
            if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
            return(code) 
          } else {
            # 纵轴映射表
            labels <- c(
              "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
              "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
            )
            if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
            return(code)
          }
        }
        
        # 3. 辅助函数：获取自定义图例标签
        get_legend_labels <- function(w_label) {
          w_names <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          base_name <- if (w_label %in% names(w_names)) w_names[[w_label]] else w_label
          return(c(paste0(base_name, "<Med"), paste0(base_name, ">Med")))
        }
        
        # 4. 辅助函数：绘制二维交互简单斜率图 (整合防重叠标签逻辑)
        generate_2way_plot <- function(slope_min_val, slope_min_raw,
                                       slope_max_val, slope_max_raw,
                                       w_main_effect,
                                       x_code, w_code, y_code, filename) {
          
          # 获取自定义标签
          x_lab_text <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
          y_lab_text <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
          legend_labs <- get_legend_labels(w_code)
          label_low  <- legend_labs[1]
          label_high <- legend_labs[2]
          
          # 定义 X 轴范围
          x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
          
          # --- 计算 Y 值 ---
          # W=0 (Min)
          b0_min <- 0
          y_min <- c(b0_min + slope_min_val * -1, b0_min + slope_min_val * 1)
          
          # W=1 (Max)
          b0_max <- w_main_effect
          y_max <- c(b0_max + slope_max_val * -1, b0_max + slope_max_val * 1)
          
          # --- 构建绘图数据框 ---
          plot_data <- data.frame(
            x = rep(x_vals, 2),
            y = c(y_min, y_max),
            Condition = rep(c(label_low, label_high), each = 2)
          )
          plot_data$Condition <- factor(plot_data$Condition, levels = c(label_low, label_high))
          
          # --- 构建标签数据 (策略性错开位置) ---
          # Low Group (W=0) 标签放在左侧 x = -0.5
          x_pos_low <- -0.5
          y_pos_low <- b0_min + slope_min_val * x_pos_low
          
          # High Group (W=1) 标签放在右侧 x = 0.5
          x_pos_high <- 0.5
          y_pos_high <- b0_max + slope_max_val * x_pos_high
          
          label_data <- data.frame(
            x = c(x_pos_low, x_pos_high),
            y = c(y_pos_low, y_pos_high),
            Condition = factor(c(label_low, label_high), levels = c(label_low, label_high)),
            Label = c(get_label_text(slope_min_raw), get_label_text(slope_max_raw))
          )
          
          # ── 颜色和线型映射 ────────────────────────────────
          color_values <- setNames(c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"), c(label_low, label_high))
          linetype_values <- setNames(c("solid", "longdash"), c(label_low, label_high))
          
          # --- 绘图 ---
          p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Condition, linetype = Condition)) +
            geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
            geom_point(size = 3) +
            
            # 添加文本标签 (带白色背景，防重叠)
            geom_label(
              data = label_data,
              aes(label = Label),
              size = 3.5,
              label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
              label.size = 0,          # 无边框
              fill = "white",          # 白色背景
              alpha = 0.9,             # 不透明度
              show.legend = FALSE
            ) +
            
            scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
            scale_linetype_manual(values = linetype_values) +
            
            labs(
              x = x_lab_text,
              y = y_lab_text
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(
              legend.title = element_blank(),
              legend.position = "inside",
              legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
              legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
              legend.box.just = "right",
              legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              panel.grid = element_blank()
            )
          
          # 确保目录存在
          dir_name <- dirname(filename)
          if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
          
          ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
          message(paste("    -> Saved plot:", filename))
        }
        
        # 5. 主循环
        data_list <- list(
          type14_i1i4 = model.result.type14_i1i4,
          type14_i1s4 = model.result.type14_i1s4,
          type14_s1i4 = model.result.type14_s1i4,
          type14_s1s4 = model.result.type14_s1s4
        )
        
        for (name in names(data_list)) {
          df <- data_list[[name]]
          message(paste("Processing Dataset:", name))
          
          # 内部辅助函数
          get_val <- function(var_name, col_name) {
            row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == var_name)
            if (nrow(row) == 0) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
            cell_str <- row[[col_name]]
            return(parse_cell(cell_str))
          }
          
          # 查找交互项行 (以 _INT 结尾)
          int_rows <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "_INT$"))
          
          filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                            "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
          
          if (nrow(int_rows) > 0) {
            for(i in 1:nrow(int_rows)) {
              int_row_data <- int_rows[i, ]
              int_var_name <- int_row_data$predictor.var 
              
              # 解析变量名
              x_name <- str_sub(int_var_name, 1, 2) 
              w_name <- str_sub(int_var_name, 3, 4) 
              
              # 尝试获取 W 的主效应行
              w_main_row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == w_name)
              
              # 遍历两列：I5.ON 和 S5.ON
              cols_to_check <- c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")
              
              for (col in cols_to_check) {
                col_label <- ifelse(col == "I5.ON", "I5", "S5")
                
                # 1. 检查交互项显著性
                res_int <- parse_cell(int_row_data[[col]])
                
                if (res_int$is_sig) {
                  message(paste0("  [", col, "] Significant Interaction: ", int_var_name))
                  
                  # 2. 提取简单斜率 (MIN 和 MAX)
                  # 注意：这里需要同时获取 value 和 raw
                  slope_min_obj <- get_val("MIN", col)
                  slope_max_obj <- get_val("MAX", col)
                  
                  # 3. 提取 W 主效应
                  w_main_val <- 0
                  if (nrow(w_main_row) > 0) {
                    val <- parse_cell(w_main_row[[col]])$value
                    if (!is.na(val)) w_main_val <- val
                  }
                  
                  # 检查数据完整性
                  if (is.na(slope_min_obj$value) || is.na(slope_max_obj$value)) {
                    message("    -> Warning: Missing MIN or MAX slope values. Skipping.")
                    next
                  }
                  
                  # 4. 绘图
                  generate_2way_plot(
                    slope_min_val = slope_min_obj$value, slope_min_raw = slope_min_obj$raw,
                    slope_max_val = slope_max_obj$value, slope_max_raw = slope_max_obj$raw,
                    w_main_effect = w_main_val,
                    x_code = x_name,       
                    w_code = w_name,       
                    y_code = col_label,    
                    filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/TwoWay_", name, "_", int_var_name, "_", col_label, ".svg")
                  )
                } 
              }
            }
          } else {
            message("  -> No interaction term (_INT) found.")
          }
        }
      }

        # 重新读取 插补数据集
        lgca_covar_MI_tics <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_covar_mi_tics_catg_conti.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        lgca_covar_MI_tics_data <- lgca_covar_MI_tics[["savedata"]]
        names(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data[["missimp_TICs_catg_conti1.dat"]])
        
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        # 读取所有最优模型结果
        ## process1
        pp_lgca_type14_4_step1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_4_r_step1.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        pp_lgca_type14_4_step1.data <- pp_lgca_type14_4_step1[["savedata"]] %>% 
          # 对 I S 进行类别化
          mutate(
            I4_std = case_when(
              I4 <= quantile(I4, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
              I4 > quantile(I4, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平
            ),
            S4_std = case_when(
              S4 <= quantile(S4, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
              S4 > quantile(S4, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平
            ),
            # I4_std = case_when(
            #   I4 <= mean(I4, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
            #   I4 > mean(I4, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平
            # ),
            # S4_std = case_when(
            #   S4 <= mean(S4, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
            #   S4 > mean(S4, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平
            # ),
            I4 = I4_std,
            S4 = S4_std
          )
        names(pp_lgca_type14_4_step1.data)
        
        # 调节变量取值范围
        wvalue_i4_min <- min(pp_lgca_type14_4_step1.data$I4_std, na.rm = TRUE)

        output.cesd8.type14_i1s4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_4_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差
        output.cesd8.type14_s1i4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_4_r_step2_cat_i_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 排行差
        output.cesd8.type14_s1s4 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type14_4_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i1i4
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type14_i1i4 <- output.cesd8.type14_i1i4[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type14_i1i4[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
        S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]

            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 2,

              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var.common %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7,
              # predictor.var.common %in% c("I_MIN","I_LO","I_MOD","I_HI","I_MAX") ~ 8,
