      #### 二维交互简单斜率图
      {
        library(tidyverse)
        library(stringr)
        library(here)
        
        # 1. 辅助函数：解析单元格 (同时提取数值和原始字符串)
        parse_cell <- function(cell_str) {
          if (length(cell_str) > 1) cell_str <- cell_str[1]
          if (is.na(cell_str)) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
          
          is_sig <- str_detect(cell_str, "[\\+\\*]")
          
          # 提取数值部分
          coef_part <- str_split(cell_str, "\n")[[1]][1]
          value_clean <- str_remove_all(coef_part, "[\\+\\*]")
          value <- as.numeric(value_clean)
          
          if (is.na(value)) return(list(value = 0, is_sig = FALSE, raw = coef_part))
          return(list(value = value, is_sig = is_sig, raw = coef_part))
        }
        
        # 辅助函数：生成标签文本 (如 b = -0.304***)
        get_label_text <- function(raw_str) {
          if (is.na(raw_str)) return("")
          return(paste0("b = ", raw_str))
        }
        
        # 2. 辅助函数：获取自定义轴标签名称
        get_axis_label <- function(code, type = "x") {
          if (type == "x") {
            # 横轴映射表
            labels <- c(
              "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
              "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
              "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
              "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
              "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
              "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
              "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
              "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
            )
            if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
            return(code) 
          } else {
            # 纵轴映射表
            labels <- c(
              "I5" = "Depression Intercept(I5)",
              "S5" = "Depression Slope(S5)"
            )
            if (code %in% names(labels)) return(labels[[code]])
            return(code)
          }
        }
        
        # 3. 辅助函数：获取自定义图例标签
        get_legend_labels <- function(w_label) {
          w_names <- c(
            "I1" = "ICE Mean Intercept(I1)",
            "S1" = "ICE Mean Slope(S1)",
            "I2" = "ICE SD_diff Intercept(I2)",
            "S2" = "ICE SD_diff Slope(S2)",
            "I3" = "ICE Gender_diff Intercept(I3)",
            "S3" = "ICE Gender_diff Slope(S3)",
            "I4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Intercept(I4)",
            "S4" = "ICE Sibling_diff Slope(S4)"
          )
          base_name <- if (w_label %in% names(w_names)) w_names[[w_label]] else w_label
          return(c(paste0(base_name, "<Med"), paste0(base_name, ">Med")))
        }
        
        # 4. 辅助函数：绘制二维交互简单斜率图 (整合防重叠标签逻辑)
        generate_2way_plot <- function(slope_min_val, slope_min_raw,
                                       slope_max_val, slope_max_raw,
                                       w_main_effect,
                                       x_code, w_code, y_code, filename) {
          
          # 获取自定义标签
          x_lab_text <- get_axis_label(x_code, "x")
          y_lab_text <- get_axis_label(y_code, "y")
          legend_labs <- get_legend_labels(w_code)
          label_low  <- legend_labs[1]
          label_high <- legend_labs[2]
          
          # 定义 X 轴范围
          x_vals <- c(-1, 1)
          
          # --- 计算 Y 值 ---
          # W=0 (Min)
          b0_min <- 0
          y_min <- c(b0_min + slope_min_val * -1, b0_min + slope_min_val * 1)
          
          # W=1 (Max)
          b0_max <- w_main_effect
          y_max <- c(b0_max + slope_max_val * -1, b0_max + slope_max_val * 1)
          
          # --- 构建绘图数据框 ---
          plot_data <- data.frame(
            x = rep(x_vals, 2),
            y = c(y_min, y_max),
            Condition = rep(c(label_low, label_high), each = 2)
          )
          plot_data$Condition <- factor(plot_data$Condition, levels = c(label_low, label_high))
          
          # --- 构建标签数据 (策略性错开位置) ---
          # Low Group (W=0) 标签放在左侧 x = -0.5
          x_pos_low <- -0.5
          y_pos_low <- b0_min + slope_min_val * x_pos_low
          
          # High Group (W=1) 标签放在右侧 x = 0.5
          x_pos_high <- 0.5
          y_pos_high <- b0_max + slope_max_val * x_pos_high
          
          label_data <- data.frame(
            x = c(x_pos_low, x_pos_high),
            y = c(y_pos_low, y_pos_high),
            Condition = factor(c(label_low, label_high), levels = c(label_low, label_high)),
            Label = c(get_label_text(slope_min_raw), get_label_text(slope_max_raw))
          )
          
          # ── 颜色和线型映射 ────────────────────────────────
          color_values <- setNames(c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"), c(label_low, label_high))
          linetype_values <- setNames(c("solid", "longdash"), c(label_low, label_high))
          
          # --- 绘图 ---
          p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Condition, linetype = Condition)) +
            geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
            geom_point(size = 3) +
            
            # 添加文本标签 (带白色背景，防重叠)
            geom_label(
              data = label_data,
              aes(label = Label),
              size = 3.5,
              label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
              label.size = 0,          # 无边框
              fill = "white",          # 白色背景
              alpha = 0.9,             # 不透明度
              show.legend = FALSE
            ) +
            
            scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
            scale_linetype_manual(values = linetype_values) +
            
            labs(
              x = x_lab_text,
              y = y_lab_text
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(
              legend.title = element_blank(),
              legend.position = "inside",
              legend.position.inside = c(.95, .95),
              legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
              legend.box.just = "right",
              legend.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              panel.grid = element_blank()
            )
          
          # 确保目录存在
          dir_name <- dirname(filename)
          if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
          
          ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
          message(paste("    -> Saved plot:", filename))
        }
        
        # 5. 主循环
        data_list <- list(
          type14_i1i4 = model.result.type14_i1i4,
          type14_i1s4 = model.result.type14_i1s4,
          type14_s1i4 = model.result.type14_s1i4,
          type14_s1s4 = model.result.type14_s1s4
        )
        
        for (name in names(data_list)) {
          df <- data_list[[name]]
          message(paste("Processing Dataset:", name))
          
          # 内部辅助函数
          get_val <- function(var_name, col_name) {
            row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == var_name)
            if (nrow(row) == 0) return(list(value = NA, is_sig = FALSE, raw = NA))
            cell_str <- row[[col_name]]
            return(parse_cell(cell_str))
          }
          
          # 查找交互项行 (以 _INT 结尾)
          int_rows <- df %>% filter(str_detect(predictor.var, "_INT$"))
          
          filename_prefix <- file.path(here("interge_rela", 
                                            "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
          
          if (nrow(int_rows) > 0) {
            for(i in 1:nrow(int_rows)) {
              int_row_data <- int_rows[i, ]
              int_var_name <- int_row_data$predictor.var 
              
              # 解析变量名
              x_name <- str_sub(int_var_name, 1, 2) 
              w_name <- str_sub(int_var_name, 3, 4) 
              
              # 尝试获取 W 的主效应行
              w_main_row <- df %>% filter(predictor.var == w_name)
              
              # 遍历两列：I5.ON 和 S5.ON
              cols_to_check <- c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")
              
              for (col in cols_to_check) {
                col_label <- ifelse(col == "I5.ON", "I5", "S5")
                
                # 1. 检查交互项显著性
                res_int <- parse_cell(int_row_data[[col]])
                
                if (res_int$is_sig) {
                  message(paste0("  [", col, "] Significant Interaction: ", int_var_name))
                  
                  # 2. 提取简单斜率 (MIN 和 MAX)
                  # 注意：这里需要同时获取 value 和 raw
                  slope_min_obj <- get_val("MIN", col)
                  slope_max_obj <- get_val("MAX", col)
                  
                  # 3. 提取 W 主效应
                  w_main_val <- 0
                  if (nrow(w_main_row) > 0) {
                    val <- parse_cell(w_main_row[[col]])$value
                    if (!is.na(val)) w_main_val <- val
                  }
                  
                  # 检查数据完整性
                  if (is.na(slope_min_obj$value) || is.na(slope_max_obj$value)) {
                    message("    -> Warning: Missing MIN or MAX slope values. Skipping.")
                    next
                  }
                  
                  # 4. 绘图
                  generate_2way_plot(
                    slope_min_val = slope_min_obj$value, slope_min_raw = slope_min_obj$raw,
                    slope_max_val = slope_max_obj$value, slope_max_raw = slope_max_obj$raw,
                    w_main_effect = w_main_val,
                    x_code = x_name,       
                    w_code = w_name,       
                    y_code = col_label,    
                    filename = paste0(filename_prefix, "/TwoWay_", name, "_", int_var_name, "_", col_label, "_4.svg")
                  )
                } 
              }
            }
          } else {
            message("  -> No interaction term (_INT) found.")
          }
        }
      }

          # 构造新文件夹result_gmm路径 
          newdir <- file.path(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))

          setwd(newdir)

          pp_lgca_fit <- mplusModeler(pp_lgca, 
                                      dataout = "pp_lgca_type21_r_step1.dat", 
                                      modelout = glue("pp_lgca_type21_r_step1.inp"), 
                                      check = TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)  
        }
        
        # 重新读取 插补数据集
        lgca_covar_MI_tics <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"lgca_covar_mi_tics_catg_conti.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        lgca_covar_MI_tics_data <- lgca_covar_MI_tics[["savedata"]]
        names(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data[["missimp_TICs_catg_conti1.dat"]])
        
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        # 读取所有最优模型结果
        ## process1
        pp_lgca_type21_step1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step1.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        pp_lgca_type21_step1.data <- pp_lgca_type21_step1[["savedata"]] %>% 
          # 对 I S 进行类别化
          mutate(
            I1_std = case_when(
              I1 <= quantile(I1, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
              I1 > quantile(I1, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平
            ),
            S1_std = case_when(
              S1 <= quantile(S1, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
              S1 > quantile(S1, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平
            ),

            #   I1 > mean(I1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平

            # ),
            I1 = I1_std,
            S1 = S1_std
          )
        names(pp_lgca_type21_step1.data)
        
        # 调节变量取值范围

        wvalue_i1_max <- max(pp_lgca_type21_step1.data$I1_std, na.rm = TRUE)

          if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
            dir.create(newdir, recursive = TRUE)
          }

          if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
            stop("目录创建失败，请检查路径和权限。")
          }

        ### i2i1

          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I2") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,

              predictor.var %in% c("S2S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)

        RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]

        here()

        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值
        output.cesd8.type31_i3i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type31_r_step2_cat_i_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type31_i3s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type31_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差

        ## 排行差

        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i3i1
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type31_i3i1 <- output.cesd8.type31_i3i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I3") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S3") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S3S1_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)

!wiis_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_min});
!
!
!
!wiis_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_max});

!!! s on i * s
!NEW (wiss_min wiss_max);
!wiss_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_min});
!
!
!
!wiss_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_max});

!!! s on s * i
!NEW (wsis_min wsis_max);
!wsis_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_min});
!
!
!
!wsis_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_i1_max});

!!! s on s * s
NEW (wsss_min wsss_max);
wsss_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_min});



wsss_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s1_max}); 

!*
!!! range for x
NEW (x_low x_high);
x_low = x_mean - sqrt(x_var);
x_high = x_mean + sqrt(x_var);

!!! range for w
NEW (w_low w_high);
w_low = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);
w_high = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);
*!
  
!*
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Simple-slope Plot 2 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! (x-axis = xvalue, y = yvalue, legend = different level of moderator)
!!! merit: the trend of y / different pattern of slope.
!
!    X_LOW    3.701      0.023    163.034      0.000
!    X_HIGH   4.464      0.020    219.375      0.000
!    W_LOW   -0.012      0.012     -1.004      0.315
!    W_HIGH   0.372      0.018     20.350      0.000


Loop(xvalue, 3.701, 4.464, 0.1);

Plot(
  
  Pwiii_lo Pwiiimod Pwiii_hi 
  Pwiis_lo Pwiismod Pwiis_hi 
  Pwiss_lo Pwissmod Pwiss_hi 
  Pwsis_lo Pwsismod Pwsis_hi 
  Pwsss_lo Pwsssmod Pwsss_hi 
  
);

!!! Direct effect(s) of Xm on Ym, conditional on Wm: (b1 + b3*W)X !!!
! b1 + b3*W

Pwiii_lo = wiii_lo * xvalue;
Pwiiimod = wiii_mod * xvalue;
Pwiii_hi = wiii_hi * xvalue;

Pwiis_lo = wiis_lo * xvalue;
Pwiismod = wiis_mod * xvalue;
Pwiis_hi = wiis_hi * xvalue;

Pwiss_lo = wiss_lo * xvalue;
Pwissmod = wiss_mod * xvalue;
Pwiss_hi = wiss_hi * xvalue;

Pwsis_lo = wsis_lo * xvalue;
Pwsismod = wsis_mod * xvalue;
Pwsis_hi = wsis_hi * xvalue;

Pwsss_lo = wsss_lo * xvalue;
Pwsssmod = wsss_mod * xvalue;
Pwsss_hi = wsss_hi * xvalue;

*!
  

!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Johnson-Neyman Plot !!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! (x-axis = moderator, y-axis = slope of predictor)
!!! merit: Johnson-neyman interval
!!! note: Johnson-Neyman Plot is only applicable with Dummy coding, not Effect coding
!
!     min                max 
! I1  {wvalue_i1_min}    {wvalue_i1_max} 
! S2  {wvalue_s1_min}    {wvalue_s1_max}
!

!!! wvalue is range of I1
!Loop (wvalue, {wvalue_i1_min}, {wvalue_i1_max}, 0.05);
!!! wvalue is range of S2
Loop (wvalue, {wvalue_s1_min}, {wvalue_s1_max}, 0.05);

Plot (
  
  !JN_wiii
  !JN_wiis
  !JN_wiss
  !JN_wsis
  JN_wsss
  
);

!!! X as focal antecedent variable

!JN_wsis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I1
JN_wsss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S2


  "),

          mutate(

              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",

              # predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4", "S4") ~ "Slope",
              # predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ "SEX",
              # predictor.var %in% c("I1SX_INT","I4SX_INT","I4SX_INT","I4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S4SX_INT","S4SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
              predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
              predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
              TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
            ))
        
        model.result.type41_s4i1  
        
        
        
        
        
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### s4s1
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type41_s4s1 <- output.cesd8.type41_s4s1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I4", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4S1_INT","S1S4_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type41_s4s1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]

!s4(x_var);

!wfdms22 wfdcs22 wfdds722 wfdds922 WITH wfdms22 wfdcs22 wfdds722 wfdds922;

        #Read all models for enumeration table
        #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
        here()
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值
        output.cesd8.type41_i4i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type4_41_r_step2_cat_i_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type41_i4s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type4_41_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差
        output.cesd8.type41_s4i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type4_41_r_step2_cat_i_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 排行差
        output.cesd8.type41_s4s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type4_41_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i4i1
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type41_i4i1 <- output.cesd8.type41_i4i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),

          mutate(
            I4_std = case_when(
              I4 <= quantile(I4, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
              I4 > quantile(I4, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平
            ),
            S4_std = case_when(
              S4 <= quantile(S4, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
              S4 > quantile(S4, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平
            ),
            # I4_std = case_when(
            #   I4 <= mean(I4, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0,  # 低水平
            #   I4 > mean(I4, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1   # 高水平

            # ),
            I4 = I4_std,
            S4 = S4_std
          )

      # 1.定义辅助函数：从compareModels输出中提取LRT统计量
      extract_lrt_info <- function(model0, model1, imputation_num) {
        # 捕获compareModels()的控制台输出
        output <- capture.output(
          compareModels(model0, model1,
                        show = c("summaries"),
                        equalityMargin = c(param = .05, pvalue = .02),
                        sort = "type", diffTest = TRUE, showNS = FALSE)
        )
        
        # 解析LRT统计量、自由度和p值
        lrt_stat <- NA
        df <- NA
        p_value <- NA
        
        # 查找包含 "Chi-square difference:" 的行
        chi_line <- grep("Chi-square difference:", output, value = TRUE)
        if (length(chi_line) > 0) {
          # 提取冒号后的所有内容，然后提取数字（包括负号）
          chi_str <- str_trim(str_extract(chi_line[1], ":\\s*(-?[0-9.]+)"))
          lrt_stat <- as.numeric(str_extract(chi_str, "-?[0-9.]+"))
        }
        
        # 查找包含 "Diff degrees of freedom:" 的行
        df_line <- grep("Diff degrees of freedom:", output, value = TRUE)
        if (length(df_line) > 0) {
          df_str <- str_trim(str_extract(df_line[1], ":\\s*([0-9]+)"))
          df <- as.numeric(str_extract(df_str, "[0-9]+"))
        }
        
        # 查找包含 "P-value:" 的行
        p_line <- grep("P-value:", output, value = TRUE)
        if (length(p_line) > 0) {
          p_str <- str_trim(str_extract(p_line[1], ":\\s*([0-9.]+)"))
          p_value <- as.numeric(str_extract(p_str, "[0-9.]+"))
        }
        
        return(data.frame(
          Imputation = imputation_num,
          LRT_ChiSquare = lrt_stat,
          DF = df,
          P_Value = p_value
        ))
      }

  ### 非线性调节效应(调节变量=binary+均值, 选用, 稳健性检验)
  {
    ###### bianry：多个调节效应分开估计(选用)
    {
      ##### 其他对均值的调节

!    W_LOW   -0.012      0.012     -1.004      0.315

              predictor.var %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type12_s1i2[["parameters"]][["r2"]]

        S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]

        output.cesd8.type13_i1s3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type13_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差
        output.cesd8.type13_s1i3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type13_r_step2_cat_i_mod_s_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 排行差
        output.cesd8.type13_s1s3 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type13_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i1i3
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type13_i1i3 <- output.cesd8.type13_i1i3[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type13_i1i3[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
        S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
        
        # 3. 提取模型拟合指数

            predictor.var = "Pseudo-R²",

          ) %>%

            I5.ON = model.fit_text.type1,

              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",

              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",

            )

wsss_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s4_min});



wsss_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_s4_max});

!*
!!! range for x
NEW (x_low x_high);
x_low = x_mean - sqrt(x_var);
x_high = x_mean + sqrt(x_var);

!!! range for w
NEW (w_low w_high);
w_low = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);
w_high = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);
*!
  
!*
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Simple-slope Plot 2 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! (x-axis = xvalue, y = yvalue, legend = different level of moderator)
!!! merit: the trend of y / different pattern of slope.
!
!    X_LOW    3.701      0.023    163.034      0.000
!    X_HIGH   4.464      0.020    219.375      0.000
!    W_LOW   -0.012      0.012     -1.004      0.315
!    W_HIGH   0.372      0.018     20.350      0.000


Loop(xvalue, 3.701, 4.464, 0.1);

Plot(
  
  Pwiii_lo Pwiiimod Pwiii_hi 
  Pwiis_lo Pwiismod Pwiis_hi 
  Pwiss_lo Pwissmod Pwiss_hi 
  Pwsis_lo Pwsismod Pwsis_hi 
  Pwsss_lo Pwsssmod Pwsss_hi 
  
);

!!! Direct effect(s) of Xm on Ym, conditional on Wm: (b1 + b3*W)X !!!
! b1 + b3*W

Pwiii_lo = wiii_lo * xvalue;
Pwiiimod = wiii_mod * xvalue;
Pwiii_hi = wiii_hi * xvalue;

Pwiis_lo = wiis_lo * xvalue;
Pwiismod = wiis_mod * xvalue;
Pwiis_hi = wiis_hi * xvalue;

Pwiss_lo = wiss_lo * xvalue;
Pwissmod = wiss_mod * xvalue;
Pwiss_hi = wiss_hi * xvalue;

Pwsis_lo = wsis_lo * xvalue;
Pwsismod = wsis_mod * xvalue;
Pwsis_hi = wsis_hi * xvalue;

Pwsss_lo = wsss_lo * xvalue;
Pwsssmod = wsss_mod * xvalue;
Pwsss_hi = wsss_hi * xvalue;

*!
  

!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!! Johnson-Neyman Plot !!!!!!!!!!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  
!!! (x-axis = moderator, y-axis = slope of predictor)
!!! merit: Johnson-neyman interval
!!! note: Johnson-Neyman Plot is only applicable with Dummy coding, not Effect coding
!
!     min                max 
! I4  {wvalue_i4_min}    {wvalue_i4_max} 
! S4  {wvalue_s4_min}    {wvalue_s4_max}
!

!!! wvalue is range of I4
!Loop (wvalue, {wvalue_i4_min}, {wvalue_i4_max}, 0.05);
!!! wvalue is range of S4
Loop (wvalue, {wvalue_s4_min}, {wvalue_s4_max}, 0.05);

Plot (
  
  !JN_wiii
  !JN_wiis
  !JN_wiss
  !JN_wsis
  JN_wsss
  
);

!!! X as focal antecedent variable
!!! Direct effect(s) of X on Y, conditional on W: (b1 + b3*W)X !!!

!JN_wiii = b1i + b3i*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I4
!JN_wiis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I4
!JN_wiss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S4
!JN_wsis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I4
JN_wsss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S4

              # predictor.var %in% c("S1SX_INT","S2SX_INT","S3SX_INT","S4SX_INT") ~ "SEX × Slope",
              predictor.var == "Intercepts" ~ "Means",
              predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
              TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值
            ))
        
        model.result.type14_s1i4  
        
        
        
        
        
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### s1s4
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type14_s1s4 <- output.cesd8.type14_s1s4[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I1") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I2", "I3", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S2", "S3", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1S2_INT","S1S3_INT","S1S4_INT","S2S1_INT","S3S1_INT","S4S1_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type14_s1s4[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
        S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]

        #Read all models for enumeration table
        #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
        here()
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值
        output.cesd8.type21_i2i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step2_cat_i_mod_i_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type21_i2s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差
        output.cesd8.type21_s2i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step2_cat_i_mod_s_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 排行差
        output.cesd8.type21_s2s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type21_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        
        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i2i1
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type21_i2i1 <- output.cesd8.type21_i2i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),

        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type31_i3i1 <- output.cesd8.type31_i3i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"

              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),

              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),

            )

!JN_wiis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I1
!JN_wiss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S2
!JN_wsis = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of I1
JN_wsss = b1s + b3s*wvalue; ! wvalue is range of S2


  "),
            
            OUTPUT = 
              "tech1 tech4 tech10 tech11 tech14 sampstat patterns stdyx;",
            
            SAVEDATA = glue(
              "FILE = pp_lgca_type41_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_MI_TICs_splitbymean_result.txt;
!SAVE = CPROB;"),
            
            PLOT =
              "type = plot3;",
            
            usevariables = colnames(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data), 
            rdata = lgca_covar_MI_tics_data,
            imputed = TRUE
          ) 
          
          # 构造新文件夹result_gmm路径 
          newdir <- file.path(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
          # 自动创建文件夹, recursive = TRUE, 覆盖原有文件夹
          if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
            dir.create(newdir, recursive = TRUE)
          }
          # 检查目录是否创建成功
          if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
            stop("目录创建失败，请检查路径和权限。")
          }
          # 设定工作目录
          setwd(newdir)   
          # 指定了要执行运算的模型, 即上面定义的包含有Mplus代码的模型    
          pp_lgca_fit <- mplusModeler(pp_lgca, 
                                      dataout = "pp_lgca_type41_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_MI_TICs_splitbymean.dat", 
                                      modelout = glue("pp_lgca_type41_r_step2_cat_s_mod_s_MI_TICs_splitbymean.inp"),
                                      check = TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE, quiet = FALSE)  
        } 
      }
      ### 均值 对 排行差(老大) 的 调节效应做表
      # depression
      {
        library(dplyr)
        library(MplusAutomation)
        library(here)
        
        #Read all models for enumeration table
        #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件

        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值
        output.cesd8.type41_i4i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type41_r_step2_cat_i_mod_i_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type41_i4s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type41_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差
        output.cesd8.type41_s4i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type41_r_step2_cat_i_mod_s_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 排行差

        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i4i1
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type41_i4i1 <- output.cesd8.type41_i4i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I4", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4S1_INT","S1S4_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type41_i4i1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]

              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4S1_INT","S1S4_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type41_s4s1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]
        S5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "S5", "est"]
        
        # 3. 提取模型拟合指数

        BIC <- summaries$BIC_Mean[1]

        TLI <- summaries$TLI_Mean[1]
        RMSEA <- summaries$RMSEA_Mean[1]

                                       ",\n BIC=", sprintf("%.2f", BIC))

              predictor.var == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Variances",
              TRUE ~ predictor.var # 默认 NA，避免杂乱值

        #Read all models for enumeration table
        #读取所有LPA模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
        here()
        filepath <- "C:/Users/LZHS/Desktop/interge_rela/result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22/"
        
        ##### 读取所有模型结果
        ## 均值
        output.cesd8.type41_i4i1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type4_41_r_step2_cat_i_mod_i_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 方差
        output.cesd8.type41_i4s1 <- readModels(paste0(filepath,"pp_lgca_type4_41_r_step2_cat_s_mod_i_splitbymean_mi_tics.out"), quiet = TRUE)
        ## 性别差

        ## 排行差

        ##### 制表模型结果
        ### i4i1
        # 1. 提取参数 (如你的代码)
        model.result.type41_i4i1 <- output.cesd8.type41_i4i1[["parameters"]][["unstandardized"]] %>% 
          mutate(
            across(c(paramHeader, param), as.character),
            outcome.var = case_when(
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "I5" ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^WIII") ~ "I5.ON",
              paramHeader %in% c("Intercepts", "Residual.Variances") & param == "S5" ~ "S5.ON",
              paramHeader == "New.Additional.Parameters" & str_detect(param, "^(WIIS|WISS|WSIS|WSSS)") ~ "S5.ON",
              TRUE ~ paramHeader
            ),
            predictor.var = case_when(
              paramHeader == "Intercepts" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Intercepts",
              paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" & param %in% c("I5", "S5") ~ "Residual.Variances",
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)"则前四个字符替换为"I"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WIII|WIIS|WSIS)") ~ paste0("I", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              # # 如果param列满足"^(WISS|WSSS)"则前四个字符替换为"S"
              # str_detect(param, "^(WISS|WSSS)") ~ paste0("S", substr(param, 5, nchar(param))),
              str_detect(param, "_MIN$") ~ "MIN",
              str_detect(param, "_LO$") ~ "LO",
              str_detect(param, "_MOD$") ~ "MOD",
              str_detect(param, "_HI$") ~ "HI",
              str_detect(param, "_MAX$") ~ "MAX",
              TRUE ~ param
            ),
            sig = case_when(
              pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
              pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
              pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
              pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
              TRUE ~ ""
            ),
            est_pval_se = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), sig, "\n(", 
                                 sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")
          ) %>% 
          filter(outcome.var %in% c("I5.ON", "S5.ON")) %>% 
          select(outcome.var, predictor.var, est_pval_se) %>% 
          pivot_wider(names_from = outcome.var, values_from = est_pval_se) %>% 
          mutate(
            # 创建辅助列 sort_group，用于排序 I1 S1 SEX11 I1SX_INT S1SX_INT
            sort_group = case_when(
              predictor.var %in% c("I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4") ~ 1,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I4", "I4") ~ 0,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4") ~ 1,         
              predictor.var %in% c("I1I2_INT","I1I3_INT","I1I4_INT","I2I1_INT","I3I1_INT","I4I1_INT") ~ 4,
              predictor.var %in% c("I1S2_INT","I1S3_INT","I1S4_INT","I2S1_INT","I3S1_INT","I4S1_INT") ~ 5,
              predictor.var %in% c("S1I2_INT","S1I3_INT","S1I4_INT","S2I1_INT","S3I1_INT","S4I1_INT") ~ 6,
              predictor.var %in% c("S4S1_INT","S1S4_INT","S1S4_INT") ~ 7
            )
          ) %>% 
          # 按照 sort_group 进行排序
          arrange(sort_group) %>% 
          select(-sort_group)
        
        
        # 2. 提取 Pseudo-R square
        r2 <- output.cesd8.type41_i4i1[["parameters"]][["r2"]]
        I5_r2 <- r2[r2$param == "I5", "est"]

        # 3. 提取模型拟合指数

            S5.ON = model.fit_text.type1

            predictor.var.common = case_when(
              # predictor.var %in% c("I1", "I4", "I4", "I4") ~ "Intercept",
              # predictor.var %in% c("S1", "S4", "S4", "S4") ~ "Slope",
              # predictor.var %in% c("SEX12") ~ "SEX",

  {
    # 非线性调节方面，将使用GMM方法获得标准差、性别差、排行差、排行差（长子）轨迹的最佳分类（most likely class）视为类别变量，使用潜调节（LMS）方法完成估计。
    # 无论 使用 SD/性别差/排行差的原始值,还是"均值标准化"值, GMM的2class类别概率分布均异常极化,
    # Gemini的关于"均值标准化"两个解决方法: "均值标准化"先取对数再基期标准化(性别差、排行差有负值,无法取对数), 或 基期标准化值 上下1%缩尾处理, 尽管可以缓解GMM类别概率极化问题, 但是带入调节效应后均不显著.
    # 只有"均值标准化"值的GMM类别结果带入调节效应后显著.
    # 
    # 故本文，坚持使用GMM类别结果带入调节效应.

i2 s2 | wfdcs12@0 wfdcs16* wfdcs18* wfdcs20* wfdcs22@1;

auxiliary=

series = wfdcs12-wfdcs22(*);",

        setwd(newdir)   
        # 指定了要执行运算的模型, 即上面定义的包含有Mplus代码的模型    
        gmm_fit <- mplusModeler(gmm, 
                                dataout = "gmm.dat", 
                                modelout = glue("c{k}_gmm.inp"), 
                                check = TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE) 
      })  
      
      
      # 枚举表 线性
      # process1 - process4
      for (pn in 4:4) {
        
        library(dplyr)
        library(MplusAutomation)
        library(here)
        
        #Read all models for enumeration table
        #读取GMM模型结果文件夹中的所有.out文件
        here()
        
        if (pn == 4) {
          
          # output.interge.time0 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("gmm_lgca_basic_p",pn,"_wfd_d1.out")), quiet = TRUE)
          # 
          # output.interge.time1 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("result_gmm1_p",pn,"_wfd_d1")), quiet = TRUE)
          # output.interge.time2 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("result_gmm2_p",pn,"_wfdid1")), quiet = TRUE)
          output.interge.time0 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("gmm_lgca_basic_p",pn,"_wfdds8.out")), quiet = TRUE) 
          
          output.interge.time1 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("result_gmm1_p",pn,"_wfd_d8")), quiet = TRUE)
          output.interge.time2 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("result_gmm2_p",pn,"_wfd_d8")), quiet = TRUE)    
        } else {
          
          #线性
          output.interge.time0 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("gmm_lgca_basic_p",pn,".out")), quiet = TRUE)
          
          output.interge.time1 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("result_gmm1_p",pn)), quiet = TRUE)
          output.interge.time2 <- readModels(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22", paste0("result_gmm2_p",pn)), quiet = TRUE)
          
        }
        
        ### Extra out在.out提供的模型拟合指标，选取最优分类
        ## 先整理PP_LGCM
        interge_extract.time0 <- LatexSummaryTable(output.interge.time0,
                                                   keepCols = c("Title", "Parameters", "LL", "AIC", "BIC",
                                                                "BLRT_PValue", "T11_VLMR_PValue", "Entropy", "Observations"))
        # 展示interge_extract.time0的列名
        colnames(interge_extract.time0)
        # Parameters LL AIC BIC Observations
        allFit.time0 <- interge_extract.time0 %>% 
          mutate(aBIC = -2*LL + Parameters * log((Observations + 2)/24)) %>%
          mutate(CIAC = -2*LL + Parameters * (log(Observations) + 1)) %>%
          mutate(AWE = -2*LL + 2*Parameters * (log(Observations) + 1.5)) %>%
          mutate(SIC = -0.5 * BIC) %>%  # 注意：原代码中为-.05，疑似笔误，应为-0.5（标准SIC公式常为-0.5 * BIC）
          # mutate(expSIC = exp(SIC - max(SIC))) %>%
          # mutate(BF = exp(SIC - dplyr::lead(SIC))) %>%
          # mutate(cmPk = expSIC / sum(expSIC)) %>%
          # relocate(proportion, .after = last_col()) %>% 
          select(1:5, 7:9) %>%  # 修正：根据注释，应为15与16列（原代码多了一个17）
          arrange(as.numeric(sub(".*-(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", Title)))  # 按照Title列中的数字部分升序排序（提取格式如" Class-K_gmm"中的K值）

        interge_extract.time2 <- LatexSummaryTable(output.interge.time2,

                                                                "BLRT_PValue", "T11_VLMR_PValue", "Entropy", "Observations"))
        
        # 函数：提取并格式化类别概率
        extract_proportions <- function(model_list, model_name) {
          prop_df <- as.data.frame(model_list[[model_name]]$class_counts$posteriorProb) %>%
            select(proportion) %>%
            mutate(proportion = round(proportion * 100, 0)) %>%
            arrange(proportion)
          prop_string <- paste(prop_df$proportion, collapse = " ")
          return(prop_string)
        }
        
        # 为 time1 添加 proportion 列
        interge_extract.time1$proportion <- NA
        for (i in 1:6) {
          model_name <- paste0("c", i, "_gmm.out")
          interge_extract.time1$proportion[i] <- extract_proportions(output.interge.time1, model_name)
        }
        
        # 为 time2 添加 proportion 列
        interge_extract.time2$proportion <- NA
        for (i in 1:6) {
          model_name <- paste0("c", i, "_gmm.out")
          interge_extract.time2$proportion[i] <- extract_proportions(output.interge.time2, model_name)
        }
        
        
        #Calculate Indices Derived from the Log Likelihood (LL)

        for (i in 1:2) {
          
          # 动态获取输入数据框
          interge_extract.time_i <- get(paste0("interge_extract.time", i))
          
          # 计算并赋值输出数据框

            mutate(AWE = -2*LL + 2*Parameters * (log(Observations) + 1.5)) %>%
            mutate(SIC = -0.5 * BIC) %>%  # 注意：原代码中为-.05，疑似笔误，应为-0.5（标准SIC公式常为-0.5 * BIC）
            mutate(expSIC = exp(SIC - max(SIC))) %>%
            mutate(BF = exp(SIC - dplyr::lead(SIC))) %>%
            mutate(cmPk = expSIC / sum(expSIC)) %>%
            relocate(proportion, .after = last_col()) %>% 
            select(1:5, 10:12, 6:8, 15:17) %>%  # 修正：根据注释，应为15与16列（原代码多了一个17）
            arrange(as.numeric(sub(".*-(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", Title)))  # 按照Title列中的数字部分升序排序（提取格式如" Class-K_gmm"中的K值）
          
          # 动态赋值给allFit.timei
          assign(paste0("allFit.time", i), allFit.time_i)
        }
        
        # 使用 rbind() 函数将三个拟合指标的数据框合并
        allFit <- rbind(
          allFit.time1, allFit.time2)

          as.data.frame(allFit),
          as.data.frame(allFit.time0)
        ) 
        
        #Format Fit Table
        #模型拟合指标做表
        tab.allFit.gmm <- allFit %>%
          mutate(Title = str_remove(Title, "_Time*")) %>% #将Title列中的字符串"_Time*"移除，以进行数据变换。
          gt() %>% #创建了一个空的gt对象,用于后续的表格构建.
          tab_header( #设置表格的标题和副标题,md()使用Markdown格式来设置标题
            title = md(paste0("**GMM_p",pn,"_Model Fit Summary Table**"))) %>%
          cols_label( #设置表格各列的标签,用于在表头显示
            Title = "Classes",
            Parameters = md("Par"),
            LL = md("*LL*"),
            T11_VLMR_PValue = "VLMR",
            Entropy = "Entropy",
            BLRT_PValue = "BLRT",
            BF = md("BF"),
            cmPk = md("*cmPk*")) %>%
          tab_footnote( #设置表格的脚注信息.
            footnote = md(
              "*Note.* Par = Parameters; *LL* = model log likelihood;
BIC = Bayesian information criterion;
aBIC = sample size adjusted BIC; CAIC = consistent Akaike information criterion;
AWE = approximate weight of evidence criterion;
BLRT = bootstrapped likelihood ratio test p-value;
VLMR = Vuong-Lo-Mendell-Rubin adjusted likelihood ratio test p-value;
BF = Bayes Factor;
*cmPk* = approximate correct model probability;
Entropy is included in the table for brevity but should not be used as a model
selection statistic (Masyn, 2013)."),
            locations = cells_title()) %>% #footnote的位置
          tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold") %>% #设置表格的选项,列标签的字体加粗.
          fmt_number(11,decimals = 3, #设置第11列Entropy的格式, 小数位数/末尾零不删除等
                     drop_trailing_zeros=FALSE,
                     suffixing = TRUE) %>%
          fmt_number(c(3:10,12),
                     decimals = 3) %>% #其他列保留3位小数.
          sub_missing(1:14,
                      missing_text = "--") %>% #设置缺失值的显示文本为"--"
          fmt(c(9:10,13), #第8\9\12列,如果x<0.001则显示为"<0.001";否则显示原值,并精确到小数点后3位.
              fns = function(x)
                ifelse(x<0.001, "<.001",

        extract_proportions <- function(model_list, model_name) {
          prop_df <- as.data.frame(model_list[[model_name]]$class_counts$posteriorProb) %>%
            select(proportion) %>%
            mutate(proportion = round(proportion * 100, 0)) %>%
            arrange(proportion)
          prop_string <- paste(prop_df$proportion, collapse = " ")
          return(prop_string)

xs_high = xs_mean + sqrt(xs_var);

s5 on s4 (b4s);
s5 on s4max_int (b5s);
i5 s5 on WFD_I12;
!*
!!! control: for long trend
! time-invar
i5 s5 on sex12 edu12 urban12 prov122 prov123;
i5 s5 on cdn12 cdar12 cdsc121 cdsc122 minor12 wave WFD_I12;

! time-var
i5 s5 on ageg12 pinc12 pinc212 cores12 heal121 heal123;
i5 s5 on marr12 hukou12 eco122 eco123 hwc122 hwc123 sat12 adl12 finc12;
*!
    ",
      
      
      MODELCONSTRAINT =
        glue(
          "
!*        
!!! i on WFD_X12 
NEW (wii_min wii_low wii_mod wii_high wii_max);
wii_min = b1i + b3i*({wvalue_max_min});
wii_low = b1i + b3i*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
wii_mod = b1i + b3i*w_mean;
wii_high = b1i + b3i*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var));
wii_max = b1i + b3i*({wvalue_max_max});

!!! i on WFD_X12
NEW (wsi_min wsi_low wsi_mod wsi_high wsi_max);
wsi_min = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_max_min});
wsi_low = b1s + b3s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
wsi_mod = b1s + b3s*w_mean;
wsi_high = b1s + b3s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var));
wsi_max = b1s + b3s*({wvalue_max_max});

!!! s on WFD_X12
NEW (wss_min wss_low wss_mod wss_high wss_max);
wss_min = b4s + b5s*({wvalue_max_min});
wss_low = b4s + b5s*(w_mean - sqrt(w_var));
wss_mod = b4s + b5s*w_mean;
wss_high = b4s + b5s*(w_mean + sqrt(w_var));
wss_max = b4s + b5s*({wvalue_max_max});
*!
!*
!!! range for x intercept
NEW (xi_low xi_high);
xi_low = xi_mean - sqrt(xi_var);
xi_high = xi_mean + sqrt(xi_var);

!!! range for x slope
NEW (xs_low xs_high);
xs_low = xs_mean - sqrt(xs_var);
xs_high = xs_mean + sqrt(xs_var);
*!

!*
!!! range for w
NEW (w_low w_high);
w_low = w_mean - sqrt(w_var);
w_high = w_mean + sqrt(w_var);
*!

  "),
      
      OUTPUT = 
        "tech1 tech4 tech8 tech10 tech11 tech14 sampstat patterns stdyx;",
      
      SAVEDATA = glue(
        "FILE = pp_lgca_type4_4_max_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r_result.txt;
!!SAVE = CPROB;"),
      
      PLOT =
        "type = plot3;",
      
      usevariables = colnames(lgca_covar_MI_tics_data), 
      rdata = lgca_covar_MI_tics_data,
      imputed = TRUE
    ) 
    
    # 构造新文件夹result_gmm路径 
    newdir <- file.path(here("interge_rela", "result_pp_lgca_continu.panel_best_clo_ces8sd_covar_time12_22"))
    # 自动创建文件夹, recursive = TRUE, 覆盖原有文件夹
    if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
      dir.create(newdir, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    # 检查目录是否创建成功
    if (!dir.exists(newdir)) {
      stop("目录创建失败，请检查路径和权限。")
    }
    # 设定工作目录
    setwd(newdir)   
    # 指定了要执行运算的模型, 即上面定义的包含有Mplus代码的模型    
    pp_lgca_fit <- mplusModeler(pp_lgca, 
                                dataout = "pp_lgca_type4_4_max_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.dat", 
                                modelout = glue("pp_lgca_type4_4_max_mod_is_MI_tics_nocontrolmean_r.inp"), 
                                check = TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE, quiet = FALSE) 
  }
